lemmas.def_en: the light provided by a burning candle

examples.en: They enjoyed a quiet dinner by candlelight in the cozy little bistro.
examples.zh: 他们在那家温馨的小餐馆里享用了一顿安静的烛光晚餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 candlelight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a guard who keeps watch

examples.en: The night watchman makes his rounds through the building every two hours.

family_guide.root_logic: 以 watchman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of the color between blue and yellow in the color spectrum; similar to the color of fresh grass

examples.en: The stagnant pond water had turned a strange greenish color over time.

family_guide.root_logic: 以 greenish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 发出刺耳的笑声，咯咯地大笑；（母鸡）咯咯叫

examples.en: The old woman began to cackle loudly at her own ridiculous joke.

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cackle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 冈斯特说唱乐（歌词常涉及犯罪和暴力）
lemmas.def_en: (Black English) a member of a youth gang

examples.en: His playlist is packed with classic gangsta rap tracks from the nineties.
examples.zh: 他的播放列表里满是九十年代经典的帮派说唱歌曲。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gangsta 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to feces

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fecal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wood of any of various eucalyptus trees valued as timber

examples.en: The soothing scent of eucalyptus filled the entire room during the massage.
examples.zh: 按摩期间，桉树舒缓的香气弥漫了整个房间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eucalyptus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: dwarf Mediterranean annual long cultivated for its aromatic seeds

examples.en: Add a pinch of ground cumin to give the soup warm flavor.
examples.zh: 加一小撮孜然粉，让汤带有一丝温热的风味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cumin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a state of deep-seated ill-will

examples.en: Years of fierce business competition fueled a bitter enmity between the rivals.
examples.zh: 多年的激烈商业竞争加深了对手之间刻骨的敌意。

lemmas.def_zh: 有敌意的, 有害的, 抵触的
lemmas.def_en: not friendly

examples.en: Excessive pride can be truly inimical to building healthy and lasting personal relationships.
examples.zh: 过度的傲慢确实可能不利于建立健康而持久的人际关系。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 enmity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cutting implement; a tool for cutting

examples.en: She carefully arranged the silver cutlery on either side of each plate.
examples.zh: 她小心翼翼地将银制餐具摆放在每个盘子的两侧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cutlery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a copy made by a xerographic printer

examples.en: Could you please make a quick xerox of this signed contract?
examples.zh: 你能把这份签好的合同快速复印一份吗？

family_guide.root_logic: 以 xerox 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 每年落叶的, 非永久性的
lemmas.def_en: (of plants and shrubs) shedding foliage at the end of the growing season

examples.en: These deciduous trees lose all their leaves before the cold winter arrives.
examples.zh: 这些落叶乔木在寒冬到来之前会掉光所有的叶子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deciduous 为核心的派生词族。

examples.en: From his nervous expression, I could easily surmise what had gone wrong.

family_guide.root_logic: 以 surmise 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大人, 阁下, 先生
lemmas.def_en: formerly a term of respect for important white Europeans in colonial India; used after the name

examples.en: The porter respectfully addressed the traveler as sahib while carrying his luggage.
examples.zh: 搬运工在帮旅客提行李时恭敬地称呼他为先生。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sahib 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: roux (Fr.)掺油面粉糊（用于做浓羹汤）

examples.zh: 不断搅拌面粉糊，直到它变成深金黄色为止。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 roux 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 乌合之众, 暴民, 下层社会, 长柄耙
lemmas.def_en: a disorderly crowd of people

examples.en: The angry rabble gathered outside the gates demanding justice from the council.
examples.zh: 愤怒的暴民聚集在大门外，要求委员会伸张正义。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rabble 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tight fitting garment worn for swimming

examples.en: She packed her favorite swimwear before heading out to the sunny beach.
examples.zh: 出发去阳光明媚的海滩前，她打包好了最喜欢的泳衣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 swimwear 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 矛盾的, 模棱两可的
lemmas.def_en: uncertain or unable to decide about what course to follow

examples.en: He felt ambivalent about accepting the promotion because of the long hours.
examples.zh: 由于工作时间长，他对是否接受升职感到心情矛盾。

lemmas.def_en: mixed feelings or emotions

examples.en: She felt deep ambivalence about accepting the lucrative job offer far from her family.
examples.zh: 对于是否接受这份远离家人的高薪工作，她感到内心十分矛盾。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ambivalent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 年老退休, 退职, 体弱退休, 淘汰, 废弃, 退休金
lemmas.def_en: a monthly payment made to someone who is retired from work

examples.en: Part of his monthly salary goes directly into a company superannuation scheme.
examples.zh: 他每月工资的一部分直接存入公司的退休养老金计划。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 superannuation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being able to provide good service

examples.en: The new software update significantly improved usability for first-time customers.
examples.zh: 新的软件更新显著提高了初次使用者的可用性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 usability 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a common venereal disease caused by the treponema pallidum spirochete; symptoms change through progressive stages; can be congenital (transmitted through the placenta)

examples.en: In the eighteenth century, chicken pox was often confused with smallpox.
examples.zh: 在十八世纪，水痘常常与天花混为一谈。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pox 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: pig iron containing manganese; used as a deoxidizing agent and to raise the manganese content in making steel

examples.zh: 工人们在铁水中加入镜铁，以提高其锰含量。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spiegel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a police officer who investigates crimes

examples.zh: 那名私家侦探在漆黑街道的对面悄悄监视着嫌疑人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tec 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (长柄有盖)深平底锅, 炖锅
lemmas.def_en: a deep pan with a handle; used for stewing or boiling

examples.en: She heated the homemade soup gently in a small stainless steel saucepan.
examples.zh: 她用一个不锈钢小炖锅温热自制的汤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 saucepan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inclined to a healthy reddish color often associated with outdoor life

examples.en: A brisk walk in the cold morning air gave him a ruddy complexion.

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ruddy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: fertility goddess in ancient Greek mythology; wife of Cronus and mother of Zeus; identified with Roman Ops and Cybele of ancient Asia Minor

examples.en: The rhea is a large flightless bird native to the South American plains.

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rhea 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a gem (usually a diamond) in a setting by itself

family_guide.root_logic: 以 solitaire 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 名副其实的, 真实的, 确实的, 真的

examples.en: The spring flower show turned the quiet village into a veritable paradise.
examples.zh: 春季花展将这个宁静的村庄变成了名副其实的天堂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 veritable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a pork and beef sausage (or a thin slice of this sausage)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pepperoni 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small guitar having four strings

examples.zh: 她一边轻弹着木制尤克里里，一边唱着温柔的民歌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ukulele 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 给……消毒，实施卫生处理；净化，粉饰（删去令人不快的信息）

examples.en: Please sanitize your hands thoroughly before entering the sterile laboratory area.

examples.zh: 那位戏剧评论家写了篇严厉的批评，深深伤害了年轻导演。

examples.zh: 一只大狒狒坐在岩石上，警惕地照看着整个猴群。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 baboon 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 在观众早已失去兴趣后，那位政客仍在激情澎湃地高谈阔论。

lemmas.def_zh: 演讲, 雄辩术, 演讲术, 雄辩

examples.zh: 他富有感染力的演讲打动了全体听众，为新政策赢得了广泛支持。

lemmas.def_zh: 演说者, 演讲者, 雄辩家, 原告, 请愿人

harangued his men in an oratorical way

lemmas.def_zh: 酒石的, 似酒石的, 含有酒石的

lemmas.def_en: a United States dry measure equal to 4 pecks or 2152.42 cubic inches

examples.zh: 这家人从自家果园里收获了一整蒲式耳的新鲜红苹果。

examples.zh: 这家人从自家果园里收获了一整蒲式耳的新鲜红苹果。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bushel 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 她决定将衣柜里多余的衣物赠送出去。

examples.zh: 亚美利哥·韦斯普奇成为了新发现的美洲大陆的命名来源。

examples.zh: 外科医生在X光片上仔细检查了下颌骨骨折的下颌支。

examples.zh: 受惊的鹿设法甩掉了捕食者，消失在森林中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 smolder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the central building block at the top of an arch or vault

examples.en: Fresh flowers were placed gently beside the ancient headstone in the quiet cemetery.
examples.zh: 静谧的墓地里，新鲜的花朵被轻轻摆放在古老的墓碑旁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 headstone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 漂积海草, 失事船只, 破坏
lemmas.def_en: dried seaweed especially that cast ashore

examples.en: Violent storms continue to wrack the small coastal village every winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天，狂暴的暴风雨都会持续摧残这个沿海小村庄。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (variant of rack, often passive) To cause severe physical or mental pain and torment to someone. 2. [T] To wreck or destroy completely.

examples.en: Violent storms continue to wrack the small coastal village every winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天，狂暴的暴风雨都会持续摧残这个沿海小村庄。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wrack 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 陵墓, 阴森森的大厦
lemmas.def_en: a large burial chamber, usually above ground

examples.en: Tourists gathered outside the marble mausoleum to admire its grand classical architecture.
examples.zh: 游客们聚集在大理石陵墓外，欣赏其宏伟的古典建筑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mausoleum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 争论, 辩论, 辩论者
lemmas.def_en: a writer who argues in opposition to others (especially in theology)

examples.en: The controversial writer published a fierce polemic attacking modern consumer culture.
examples.zh: 这位备受争议的作家发表了一篇激烈的辩论文，抨击现代消费文化。

lemmas.def_zh: 好辩的；好争论的；挑起论战的
lemmas.def_en: of or involving dispute or controversy
involving controversy

examples.en: criticism too polemically stated

family_guide.root_logic: 以 polemic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: medium for radio and television broadcasting

examples.en: The breaking news report dominated the radio airwaves for the rest of the evening.
examples.zh: 这则突发新闻报道在当晚剩下的时间里占据了广播电波。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 airwave 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a wind that blows from the north

examples.en: A sudden norther swept across the plains, causing temperatures to plunge dramatically.
examples.zh: 一股强烈的北风席卷了平原，导致气温急剧下降。

lemmas.def_en: a wind that blows from the north

family_guide.root_logic: 以 norther 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 麻疯病患者, 受蔑视的人
lemmas.def_en: a person afflicted with leprosy

examples.en: Historically, any person suffering from this contagious disease was treated as a leper.
examples.zh: 在历史上，任何患有这种传染病的人都会被视作麻风病人受人唾弃。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 甘美的, 浓厚的, 满足感官的
lemmas.def_en: having strong sexual appeal

examples.en: We enjoyed a basket of luscious ripe peaches freshly picked from the summer garden.
examples.zh: 我们享用了一篮刚从夏日果园采摘的甜美多汁的熟桃子。

lemmas.def_en: so as to produce a delightful taste

examples.en: I bought some more of these deliciously sweet peaches

lemmas.def_en: extreme appetizingness

family_guide.root_logic: 以 luscious 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: paper made from the papyrus plant by cutting it in strips and pressing it flat; used by ancient Egyptians and Greeks and Romans

examples.en: Tall papyrus reeds swayed gently along the banks of the ancient river.
examples.zh: 高大的纸莎草在古老河流的岸边随风轻轻摇曳。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 papyrus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a window in a roof to admit daylight

examples.en: Natural sunlight poured through the wide skylight, illuminating the entire artist studio.
examples.zh: 自然阳光穿过宽大的天窗倾泻而下，照亮了整个艺术工作室。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 skylight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a stupid person who is easy to take advantage of

examples.en: He felt like an absolute berk after realizing he had locked his keys inside.
examples.zh: 在意识到自己把钥匙锁在屋里后，他觉得自己简直是个蠢货。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 berk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To take a machine, structure, or piece of equipment apart into its separate pieces.

examples.en: The mechanic had to disassemble the entire engine to locate the damaged internal part.
examples.zh: 机械师不得不拆开整个发动机，以找出受损的内部零件。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disassemble 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the pointed head or striking tip of an arrow

examples.en: The archaeologist found a perfectly preserved flint arrowhead buried deep in the dry soil.
examples.zh: 考古学家在干燥的土壤深处发现了一枚保存完好的燧石箭头。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arrowhead 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a long narrow depression in a surface

examples.en: A tiny green lizard darted into a rocky crevice to escape the midday heat.
examples.zh: 一只小绿蜥蜴蹿进岩石裂缝中躲避正午的酷热。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crevice 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: nonpasserine large-headed bird with a short tail and long sharp bill; usually crested and bright-colored; feed mostly on fish

examples.en: A brilliant blue kingfisher perched on the branch before diving swiftly into the clear stream.
examples.zh: 一只羽毛鲜艳的蓝翠鸟停在树枝上，随后敏捷地跃入清澈的溪流中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kingfisher 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 狭长小船, 两头尖的平底船, 吊监, 吊舱, 无盖货车
lemmas.def_en: a low flat-bottomed freight car with fixed sides but no roof

examples.en: The tourists enjoyed a romantic ride in a traditional gondola along the quiet canal.
examples.zh: 游客们乘坐传统的狭长小船，沿着宁静的运河享受浪漫的旅程。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gondola 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To support or reinforce a wall with a buttress. 2. [T] To strengthen or support an argument, belief, or system.

examples.en: The scientist presented new experimental data to buttress her controversial theory on climate change.
examples.zh: 这位科学家提出了新的实验数据，以支持她关于气候变化的争议性理论。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 buttress 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 保皇党员, 顽固分子
lemmas.def_en: an advocate of the principles of monarchy

examples.en: During the civil war, the stubborn royalist refused to swear allegiance to the new parliament.
examples.zh: 在内战期间，这位顽固的保皇派拒绝宣誓效忠新议会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 royalist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 没精打采的样子, 耷拉, 笨人
lemmas.def_en: an incompetent person; usually used in negative constructions

examples.en: Do not slouch in your chair during the interview, as good posture shows confidence.
examples.zh: 面试时不要耷拉着身子坐在椅子上，因为良好的坐姿展现出自信。

lemmas.def_zh: 耷拉着坐（或站、走），无精打采地弓背
lemmas.def_en: [I] To sit, stand, or walk with a lazy, drooping posture, bending your shoulders forward.

examples.en: Do not slouch in your chair during the interview, as good posture shows confidence.
examples.zh: 面试时不要耷拉着身子坐在椅子上，因为良好的坐姿展现出自信。

lemmas.def_zh: 没精打采的, 不整齐的
lemmas.def_en: lacking stiffness in form or posture

examples.en: a slouchy sweater

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slouch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 放声痛哭；大声叫嚷，怒吼
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To shout, call out, or cry very loudly and noisily; to scold angrily.

examples.en: The hungry toddler began to bawl loudly when his mother took away the toy.
examples.zh: 当母亲拿走玩具时，那个饥饿的幼儿开始放声大哭。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bawl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a plaything consisting of a Y-shaped stick with elastic between the arms; used to propel small stones

examples.en: The mischievous boy used a wooden slingshot to launch small pebbles at the empty cans.
examples.zh: 那个淘气的男孩用木弹弓向空罐子发射小石子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slingshot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 时代错误, 不合潮流的人(物)
lemmas.def_en: something located at a time when it could not have existed or occurred

examples.en: Seeing a modern digital watch in the medieval period drama felt like an obvious anachronism.
examples.zh: 在这部中世纪历史剧中看到现代电子表，感觉是一个明显的时代错误。

lemmas.def_en: chronologically misplaced

examples.en: English public schools are anachronistic

lemmas.def_en: in an anachronistic manner

examples.en: let's look at this phenomenon anachronistically

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anachronism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a vehicle mounted on runners and pulled by horses or dogs; for transportation over snow

examples.en: The excited family decided to sleigh down the snowy slope after the heavy morning blizzard.
examples.zh: 清晨的一场暴风雪过后，兴奋的一家人决定乘雪橇冲下积雪的山坡。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to travel or transport someone or something in a sleigh over snow.

examples.en: The excited family decided to sleigh down the snowy slope after the heavy morning blizzard.
examples.zh: 清晨的一场暴风雪过后，兴奋的一家人决定乘雪橇冲下积雪的山坡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sleigh 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of racket strokes) made across the body with back of hand facing direction of stroke

examples.en: The tennis player managed to backhand the fast-approaching ball past her stunned opponent.
examples.zh: 网球手成功反手击出飞速而来的球，越过了目瞪口呆的对手。

lemmas.def_zh: 用反手击（球）；反手击打，掌掴
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (sports) To hit a ball with a backhand stroke. 2. [T] To strike someone with the back of the hand.

examples.en: The tennis player managed to backhand the fast-approaching ball past her stunned opponent.
examples.zh: 网球手成功反手击出飞速而来的球，越过了目瞪口呆的对手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 backhand 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 举行赛会的场所, 露天市场
lemmas.def_en: an open area for holding fairs or exhibitions or circuses

examples.en: Loud music and the smell of sweet popcorn drifted across the crowded summer fairground.
examples.zh: 嘈杂的音乐和甜米花的香气在拥挤的夏日露天游乐场中弥漫开来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fairground 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the ratio of two quantities to be divided

examples.en: Divide the total profit by the number of partners to find each person's fair quotient.
examples.zh: 将总利润除以合伙人数，即可得出每个人应得的公平份额。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quotient 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a complex neural structure (shaped like a sea horse) consisting of grey matter and located on the floor of each lateral ventricle; intimately involved in motivation and emotion as part of the limbic system; has a central role in the formation of memories

examples.en: Researchers studied how damage to the hippocampus affects long-term memory formation in the human brain.
examples.zh: 研究人员研究了大脑海马体受损如何影响人类长期记忆的形成。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hippocampus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 遥测技术, 遥测数据
lemmas.def_en: automatic transmission and measurement of data from remote sources by wire or radio or other means

examples.en: Engineers monitored the rocket's telemetry data carefully throughout the critical launch phase into space.
examples.zh: 在发射进入太空的关键阶段，工程师们仔细监控着火箭的遥测数据。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 telemetry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: usually small round bread that can open into a pocket for filling

examples.en: We stuffed the warm pita pocket with grilled chicken, fresh lettuce, and garlic sauce.
examples.zh: 我们在温热的皮塔饼中塞满了烤鸡肉、新鲜生菜和蒜蓉酱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pita 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: miscellaneous curios

examples.en: She displayed a charming collection of miniature porcelain figurines on the corner whatnot.
examples.zh: 她在角落的古董架上摆放了一组精致的微型瓷俑藏品。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whatnot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: thick dark syrup produced by boiling down juice from sugar cane; especially during sugar refining

examples.en: The baker poured thick, dark molasses into the dough to give the cookies their rich flavor.
examples.zh: 烘焙师将浓稠深色的糖蜜倒入面团中，赋予饼干浓郁的风味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 molasses 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: echinoderms characterized by five arms extending from a central disk

examples.en: Children knelt by the tide pool to gently touch an orange starfish.
examples.zh: 孩子们跪在潮水潭边，轻轻触摸一只橙色的海星。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 starfish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a man who is the lover of a girl or young woman

examples.en: The shy swain picked fresh wildflowers every morning for his beloved.
examples.zh: 这位害羞的乡下青年每天早晨都为心上人采摘新鲜的野花。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 swain 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a period of time during which there is no war

examples.en: The nation maintained a relatively small military force during decades of peacetime.
examples.zh: 在数十年的和平时期，该国维持着一支规模相对较小的军队。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peacetime 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: chronic granulomatous communicable disease occurring in tropical and subtropical regions; characterized by inflamed nodules beneath the skin and wasting of body parts; caused by the bacillus Mycobacterium leprae

examples.en: Ancient medical texts frequently described the social isolation caused by leprosy.
examples.zh: 古代医学文献频繁记载了麻风病所导致的社会隔离。

lemmas.def_zh: 麻疯病的, 患麻疯病的, 鳞状的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or resembling or having leprosy

examples.en: The ancient tree trunk had a strange, dry, leprous texture across its bark.
examples.zh: 那棵古树的树皮呈现出一种奇怪而干燥的鳞状脱屑质感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leprosy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of the western part of a city

examples.en: She bought a charming apartment on a quiet westside neighborhood street.
examples.zh: 她在西区一条安静的街道上买了一套迷人的公寓。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 westside 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 子孙, 后裔, 成果
lemmas.def_en: the immediate descendants of a person

examples.en: The prize-winning stallion produced many progeny that dominated subsequent races.
examples.zh: 这匹屡获殊荣的种马留下了许多后代，在随后的比赛中独占鳌头。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 progeny 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: vigorous and enthusiastic enjoyment

examples.en: The hungry hikers devoured their warm campfire meal with immense gusto.
examples.zh: 饥饿的徒步旅行者兴致勃勃地狼吞虎咽着篝火热餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gusto 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 游戏时间, 娱乐时间, 演出时间, 开幕时刻
lemmas.def_en: time for play or diversion

examples.en: The teacher signaled that morning playtime was over and gathered everyone inside.
examples.zh: 老师示意上午的游戏时间结束，将大家集合到室内。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 playtime 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not distinguished on the basis of sex

examples.en: The fashion brand launched a minimalist unisex collection suited for everyone.
examples.zh: 该时尚品牌推出了适合所有人的极简风格中性系列。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unisex 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: slender flexible branches or twigs (especially of willow or some canes); used for wickerwork

examples.en: They enjoyed afternoon tea while resting on comfortable wicker chairs outside.
examples.zh: 他们坐在室外舒适的柳条椅上，惬意地享用下午茶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wicker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or determined by position

examples.en: Chess masters rely heavily on subtle positional advantages rather than brute force.
examples.zh: 国际象棋大师在很大程度上依赖微妙的位置优势而非蛮力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 positional 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to uniform movement without rotation

examples.en: The physics experiment measured both rotational motion and translational velocity accurately.
examples.zh: 该物理实验准确测量了旋转运动和平移速度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 translational 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 赛马场, 水道, 跑道
lemmas.def_en: a course over which races are run

examples.en: Thousands of excited spectators cheered as the horses entered the final racecourse.
examples.zh: 当马匹进入最后的赛马跑道时，成千上万兴奋的观众欢呼起来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 racecourse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (football) the running back who plays the offensive halfback position

examples.en: The agile halfback intercepted the opponent's pass and initiated a counterattack.
examples.zh: 这位敏捷的前卫截断了对手的传球，并迅速发起反击。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 halfback 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 鹰嘴豆泥, 鹰嘴豆沙
lemmas.def_en: a thick spread made from mashed chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice and garlic; used especially as a dip for pita; originated in the Middle East

examples.en: She dipped warm pita bread into a bowl of creamy garlic hummus.
examples.zh: 她把温热的皮塔饼蘸进一碗绵密的蒜香鹰嘴豆泥中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hummus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 拙劣的模仿作品, 嘲弄, 滑稽模仿
lemmas.def_en: a comedy characterized by broad satire and improbable situations

examples.en: Critics called the rigged trial a complete travesty of fair legal justice.
examples.zh: 批评人士称，那场被操纵的审判是对公平司法的彻头彻尾的嘲弄。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 travesty 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: that is going out or leaving

examples.en: Bad weather caused severe delays for all outbound flights this afternoon.
examples.zh: 恶劣的天气导致今天下午所有出境航班严重延误。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outbound 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: work assigned to and done by a student during a course of study; usually it is evaluated as part of the student's grade in the course

examples.en: Students must submit all their final coursework before the semester officially ends.
examples.zh: 学生必须在学期正式结束前提交所有的期末课程作业。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coursework 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an assembly of witches; usually 13 witches

examples.en: Legends say a secret coven gathered in the dark forest every full moon.
examples.zh: 传说每个满月之夜，都会有一个秘密女巫集会聚集在幽暗的森林中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coven 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or affecting the colon and the rectum

examples.en: Routine medical screenings significantly reduce the risk of advanced colorectal cancer.
examples.zh: 常规医疗筛查可显著降低患晚期结直肠癌的风险。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 colorectal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小狗, 狗儿(对狗的爱称)
lemmas.def_en: informal terms for dogs

examples.en: The little girl happily hugged her cute doggie after returning from school.
examples.zh: 小女孩放学回家后，开心地抱住了她可爱的小狗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doggie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一般的, 普遍的, 全基督教的, 泛基督教主义的
lemmas.def_en: concerned with promoting unity among churches or religions

examples.en: Various church leaders gathered to celebrate an inspiring ecumenical prayer service.
examples.zh: 各教会领袖齐聚一堂，举行了一场令人振奋的普世祷告仪式。

lemmas.def_en: a movement promoting union between religions (especially between Christian churches)

examples.en: The local leaders promoted ecumenism by organizing joint charity events between churches.
examples.zh: 当地领袖通过组织各教会间的联合慈善活动来倡导普世主义。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ecumenical 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 独石的, 完全统一的, 整体的
lemmas.def_en: imposing in size or bulk or solidity

examples.en: The company is replacing its monolithic software architecture with flexible microservices.
examples.zh: 该公司正用灵活的微服务取代其庞大单一的软件架构。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 monolithic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone deranged and possibly dangerous

examples.en: Pay no attention to that looney shouting nonsense on the street corner.
examples.zh: 别理会那个在街角大喊胡话的疯子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 looney 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or located in the endothelium

examples.en: Chronic inflammation can damage endothelial cells lining the inner surface of blood vessels.
examples.zh: 慢性炎症会损伤衬在血管内表面的内皮细胞。

lemmas.def_en: an epithelium of mesoblastic origin; a thin layer of flattened cells that lines the inside of some body cavities

examples.en: Chronic high blood pressure can cause significant damage to the vascular endothelium over time.
examples.zh: 长期高血压随着时间的推移会对血管内皮造成严重损伤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 endothelial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: indiscriminate slaughter

examples.en: Investors panicked as tech stocks suffered an unprecedented bloodbath this morning.
examples.zh: 由于科技股今早遭遇前所未有的惨烈暴跌，投资者陷入恐慌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bloodbath 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 发热的, 极度兴奋的, 不安的
lemmas.def_en: marked by intense agitation or emotion

examples.en: The laboratory team worked at a feverish pace to meet the project deadline.
examples.zh: 实验团队以狂热的快节奏工作以赶上项目截止日期。

lemmas.def_en: in a feverish manner

examples.en: she worked feverishly

family_guide.root_logic: 以 feverish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a form of government in which the ruler is an absolute dictator (not restricted by a constitution or laws or opposition etc.)

examples.en: Citizens protested in the streets to defend democracy against rising authoritarianism.
examples.zh: 市民在街头抗议，以捍卫民主免受日益抬头的独裁主义侵害。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 authoritarianism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 神秘的气氛, 奥秘, 秘诀
lemmas.def_en: an aura of heightened value or interest or meaning surrounding a person or thing

examples.en: The reclusive author deliberately maintained an aura of mystique throughout his career.
examples.zh: 这位隐居作家在整个职业生涯中刻意保持着一种神秘感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mystique 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (chemistry) a colloid in which both phases are liquids

examples.en: Shake the bottle well until the oil and vinegar form a smooth emulsion.
examples.zh: 充分摇晃瓶子，直到油和醋形成均匀的乳状液。

lemmas.def_en: a surface-active agent that promotes the formation of an emulsion
[I, T] (chemistry / cooking) to mix two liquids that normally do not blend (such as oil and water) into a smooth, stable emulsion, or to become mixed in this way

examples.en: Whisk the vinegar and olive oil vigorously until they completely emulsify together.
examples.zh: 用力搅拌醋和橄榄油，直到它们完全乳化在一起。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 emulsion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: transient cessation of respiration

examples.en: The doctor recommended a special breathing machine to treat his severe sleep apnea.
examples.zh: 医生推荐使用特制呼吸机来治疗他严重的睡眠呼吸暂停。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 apnea 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不老实的, 不诚实的, 狡猾的
lemmas.def_en: not straightforward or candid; giving a false appearance of frankness; - David Cannadine

examples.en: His innocent smile seemed completely disingenuous after what he had secretly done.
examples.zh: 在他暗中做了那些事后，他天真的微笑显得极其虚伪。

lemmas.def_zh: 不诚实地, 不坦白地
lemmas.def_en: in a disingenuous manner

examples.en: disingenuously, he asked leading questions abut his opponent's work

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being disingenuous and lacking candor

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disingenuous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 终结, 满期, 呼气, 断气
lemmas.def_en: a coming to an end of a contract period

examples.en: Please make sure to renew your passport several months before its expiry.
examples.zh: 请务必在护照到期前几个月进行更换。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 expiry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a speech defect that involves pronouncing `s' like voiceless `th' and `z' like voiced `th'

examples.en: The young boy spoke with a slight lisp whenever he was nervous.
examples.zh: 这个小男孩一紧张说话就会带点大舌头。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lisp 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 离开着, 偏离着, 在战场上
lemmas.def_en: far away from home or one's usual surroundings; - R.A.Hall

examples.en: The researchers traveled far afield to study rare plant species in remote valleys.
examples.zh: 研究人员远赴偏远山谷去研究稀有植物物种。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 afield 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: drops of fresh water that fall as precipitation from clouds

examples.en: The eco-friendly farm collects rainwater in large barrels to irrigate its crops.
examples.zh: 这个生态农场用大桶收集雨水来灌溉农作物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rainwater 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a synthetic silklike fabric

examples.en: This lightweight summer dress is made of soft rayon that drapes beautifully.
examples.zh: 这件轻便的夏装采用垂坠感极好的柔软人造丝制成。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rayon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 哈里发(穆罕穆德的继承人)
lemmas.def_en: the civil and religious leader of a Muslim state considered to be a representative of Allah on earth

examples.en: The historical mosque was constructed during the glorious reign of the fifth caliph.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的清真寺建于第五任哈里发的辉煌统治时期。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caliph 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (formal) (of time) to pass or slip by

examples.en: Several hours must elapse before the glue fully cures and bonds securely.
examples.zh: 必须过去几个小时胶水才能完全固化并牢固粘合。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 elapse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 旁观者, 袖手旁观者
lemmas.def_en: someone who looks on

examples.en: A curious onlooker quickly dialed emergency services after witnessing the collision.
examples.zh: 一名好奇的旁观者在目睹碰撞事故后迅速拨打了急救电话。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 onlooker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 地志学, 拓扑学, 局部解剖学
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to topology

examples.en: The subway map preserves topological connections while completely ignoring real geographic distances.
examples.zh: 地铁地图保留了拓扑连接，同时完全忽略了实际地理距离。

lemmas.def_en: from the point of view of topology

family_guide.root_logic: 以 topological 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 色迷迷地看，斜着眼不怀好意地看
lemmas.def_en: [I] to look or stare at someone in an unpleasant, malicious, or sexually suggestive way

examples.en: The creepy stranger began to leer at the women sitting across the train.
examples.zh: 那个令人毛骨悚然的陌生人开始不怀好意地斜眼看着坐在对面的女士。

lemmas.def_zh: 机敏的, 猜疑的, 狡猾的
lemmas.def_en: openly distrustful and unwilling to confide

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 兵舍, 军营, 木柴
lemmas.def_en: a short personal letter

examples.en: Workers stacked each steel billet carefully before sending them to the rolling mill.
examples.zh: 工人们在将每根钢坯送往轧钢机前都仔细码放整齐。

lemmas.def_zh: （尤指为军队）安排临时住宿；使寄宿
lemmas.def_en: [T] To assign or provide temporary lodging for soldiers or other personnel, especially in civilian accommodation.

examples.en: Workers stacked each steel billet carefully before sending them to the rolling mill.
examples.zh: 工人们在将每根钢坯送往轧钢机前都仔细码放整齐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 billet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 废除主义者, 废奴主义者
lemmas.def_en: a reformer who favors abolishing slavery

examples.en: The brave abolitionist dedicated her entire life to ending the practice of slavery.
examples.zh: 这位勇敢的废奴主义者毕生致力于终结奴隶制。

lemmas.def_zh: 废除主义, 废奴主义
lemmas.def_en: the doctrine that calls for the abolition of slavery

examples.en: During the nineteenth century, abolitionism gained widespread moral and political momentum across northern states.
examples.zh: 十九世纪期间，废奴主义在北方各州赢得了广泛的道德和政治声势。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 abolitionist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a formal reception of visitors or guests (as at a royal court)

examples.en: Volunteers stacked sandbags frantically to prevent the rising river from topping the levee.
examples.zh: 志愿者们疯狂地堆放沙袋，以防止上涨的河水漫过大堤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 levee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any seed plant yielding balsam

examples.en: Clusters of vibrant pink balsam bloomed along the garden border throughout the summer.
examples.zh: 整个夏天，一簇簇鲜艳的粉色凤仙花沿着花园边缘盛开。

lemmas.def_zh: 香膏质的, 如香油的, 镇静的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or containing balsam

examples.en: a balsamic fragrance

family_guide.root_logic: 以 balsam 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 拉开（……的）拉链；解压缩（计算机文件）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To open clothing, a bag, etc. by pulling the zipper open, or to become unfastened by a zipper. 2. [T] (computing) To decompress a zipped file.

examples.en: He sat down on the bench to unzip his heavy winter coat.
examples.zh: 他坐在长椅上拉开厚重冬衣的拉链。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unzip 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 刺穿，扎透（尤指被尖物穿透）
lemmas.def_en: [T] To pierce through someone or something with a sharp, pointed object like a stake, spear, or spike.

examples.en: The clumsy knight managed to impale his shield on a sharp branch.
examples.zh: 笨拙的骑士不小心把盾牌刺穿在一根锋利的树枝上。

lemmas.def_en: the act of piercing with a sharpened stake as a form of punishment or torture

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impale 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 再试，重新尝试；（法律）重审，再审
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. to attempt or try doing something again. 2. (law) to try a defendant or legal case a second time in court.

examples.en: If the payment fails, please wait a minute and retry the transaction.
examples.zh: 如果付款失败，请稍等片刻然后重试交易。

lemmas.def_zh: 再审, 复试, 再试验
lemmas.def_en: a new trial in which issues already litigated and to which the court has already rendered a verdict or decision are reexamined by the same court; occurs when the initial trial is found to have been improper or unfair due to procedural errors

family_guide.root_logic: 以 retry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a wicked or evil person; someone who does evil deliberately

examples.en: That deceitful scoundrel vanished with all the money we had saved together.
examples.zh: 那个狡诈的恶棍带着我们所有的积蓄潜逃了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scoundrel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使慌乱，使局促不安，使胆怯
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (informal, chiefly negative) To disturb, shock, or upset someone's calm confidence.

examples.en: The tough interview questions did not seem to faze the experienced candidate.
examples.zh: 苛刻的面试问题似乎丝毫没有难倒那位经验丰富的求职者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 faze 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a young unmarried woman

examples.en: The old fairy tale depicts a brave warrior rescuing a distressed damsel.
examples.zh: 古老的神话故事描述了一位英勇的武士解救受难少女的情节。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 damsel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 内地, 腹地, 偏僻地区

examples.zh: 这座繁忙的沿海港口与广袤的农业腹地进行着频繁的贸易。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hinterland 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a Communist who tries to rewrite Marxism to justify a retreat from the revolutionary position

examples.en: The critic dismissed the controversial historian as a dangerous political revisionist.
examples.zh: 评论家驳斥这位饱受争议的历史学家是一个危险的政治修正主义者。

lemmas.def_en: any dangerous departure from the teachings of Marx

examples.en: Critics accused the controversial historian of historical revisionism regarding the events of the war.
examples.zh: 批评人士指责这位颇具争议的历史学家在战争事件上搞历史修正主义。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 revisionist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: visual examination of the interior of a hollow body organ by use of an endoscope

examples.zh: 医生建议进行内窥镜检查，以明确腹痛的原因。

examples.en: The surgeon carefully inserted the flexible endoscope to inspect the patient's stomach lining.
examples.zh: 外科医生小心地插入软式内窥镜，以检查患者的胃壁。

lemmas.def_zh: 内窥镜的, 用内窥镜检查的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to endoscopy

family_guide.root_logic: 以 endoscopy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 闷热的, 粗暴的, 放荡的, 激烈的

examples.zh: 我们在闷热的夏夜坐在户外悠闲地喝着冰茶。

lemmas.def_zh: 闷热, 急躁, 纵情声色
lemmas.def_en: oppressively hot and humid weather

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sultry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 楔子, 栓, 系缆墩

examples.en: He tied the boat rope securely around the metal cleat on dock.
examples.zh: 他把系船缆绳牢牢地系在码头的金属系缆墩上。

lemmas.def_zh: 用系缆栓系牢（绳索）；给……加固夹板
lemmas.def_en: [T] To secure a rope to a cleat, or to strengthen something with cleats.

examples.en: He tied the boat rope securely around the metal cleat on dock.
examples.zh: 他把系船缆绳牢牢地系在码头的金属系缆墩上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cleat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一副假牙, 一副牙齿, 齿列

examples.en: The elderly man removed his denture before going to sleep each night.
examples.zh: 这位老人每天晚上睡觉前都会取下自己的假牙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 denture 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of unselfish concern for the welfare of others

examples.en: True altruism means helping other people without expecting any reward or recognition in return.
examples.zh: 真正的利他主义意味着帮助他人而不求任何回报或认可。

lemmas.def_zh: 利他主义者, 无私者
lemmas.def_en: someone who makes charitable donations intended to increase human well-being

examples.en: A dedicated altruist, she spent her fortune funding shelters for homeless families.
examples.zh: 作为一位虔诚的利他主义者，她倾尽财富资助无家可归者的庇护所。

lemmas.def_en: showing unselfish concern for the welfare of others
in an altruistic manner

examples.en: he acted selflessly when he helped the old lady in distress

family_guide.root_logic: 以 altruist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 肮脏的, 贪婪的, 卑鄙的, 恶劣的, 暗淡的
lemmas.def_en: morally degraded; ; ; ; - Seattle Weekly; - James Joyce

examples.en: The newspaper revealed the sordid details of the corrupt politician's private life.
examples.zh: 报纸披露了那位腐败政客私生活中肮脏不堪的细节。

lemmas.def_zh: 肮脏; 污秽; 卑鄙; 可耻
lemmas.def_en: sordid dirtiness

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sordid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (literary) To tear or split something apart violently; to divide into pieces or factions.

examples.zh: 内部的权力斗争极有可能将这个古老王朝撕裂成对立的派系。

lemmas.def_zh: 撕裂，分裂，劈开（rive的过去分词）
lemmas.def_en: [T] (literary) Past participle of rive: violently split, torn apart, or divided.

examples.en: The curtain ripped from top to bottom
pull the cooked chicken into strips

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 公国, 封色, 侯国, 首长的职位, 校长的权力, 校长的职位, 首长的权力
lemmas.def_en: territory ruled by a prince

examples.zh: 摩纳哥是一个以奢华和赌场闻名的欧洲小公国。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 principality 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (formal) To reproduce and produce biological offspring.

examples.en: Most animals migrate long distances simply to find safe places to procreate.
examples.zh: 大多数动物长途迁徙仅仅是为了寻找安全的地方繁衍后代。

lemmas.def_en: the sexual activity of conceiving and bearing offspring

lemmas.def_zh: 会生产的, 有生殖力的
lemmas.def_en: producing new life or offspring

examples.en: the reproductive potential of a species is its relative capacity to reproduce itself under optimal conditions
the reproductive or generative organs

family_guide.root_logic: 以 procreate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the arch of bone beneath the eye that forms the prominence of the cheek

examples.zh: 化妆师涂抹高光以凸显她那轮廓分明的高颧骨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cheekbone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不适当, 不足之处, 不充分

examples.en: His quiet voice masked a persistent feeling of inadequacy at work.
examples.zh: 他轻柔的话语掩盖了自己在工作中挥之不去的不足感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inadequacy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使布满斑点，弄上斑点；点缀
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ with) (often passive) To mark or cover a surface with many small spots or patches.

examples.en: Tiny freckles speckle her nose whenever she spends time under sunlight.
examples.zh: 每当她在阳光下待一会儿，小雀斑就会点缀在她的鼻梁上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 speckle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 打兰, 少量的酒(或饮料), 微量, 动态随机存取存储器
lemmas.def_en: a unit of apothecary weight equal to an eighth of an ounce or to 60 grains

examples.en: After a freezing walk in the snow, he craved a dram of whiskey.
examples.zh: 在雪地里冰冷地漫步之后，他渴望喝上一小口威士忌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dram 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one of the minor orders in the unreformed Western Church but now suppressed in the Roman Catholic Church

examples.en: Locals sought the help of an experienced exorcist to cleanse the house.
examples.zh: 当地居民寻求一位经验丰富的驱魔人的帮助来净化这栋房子。

lemmas.def_zh: 驱魔, 驱邪所用的咒语
lemmas.def_en: freeing from evil spirits

examples.en: The priest performed a solemn exorcism to drive the evil presence away.
examples.zh: 神父举行了庄严的驱魔仪式以驱逐邪灵。

lemmas.def_zh: 拔除, 除怪, 驱邪, 从...驱除妖魔, (用咒语)驱除(妖魔)
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To expel an evil spirit from a person or place using religious prayers, or free the mind from an obsession.

examples.en: The priest was summoned to exorcize the dark entity dwelling inside the house.
examples.zh: 牧师被召来驱逐盘踞在这座房子里的邪恶幽灵。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 exorcist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 碎步急跑，疾走；仓促奔跑

examples.en: Mice scurried across the kitchen floor as soon as the light was turned on.
examples.zh: 灯一打开，老鼠就匆匆穿过厨房地板逃窜。

lemmas.def_en: moving hurriedly with quick, short steps

examples.en: We heard the scurrying sounds of mice behind the pantry wall.
examples.zh: 我们听到了储藏室墙后老鼠急促窜动的声音。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scurry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an attendant at the court of a sovereign

examples.en: The ambitious courtier flattered the king daily in hopes of gaining political influence.
examples.zh: 野心勃勃的侍臣每天奉承国王，希望能获得政治影响力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 courtier 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] When hot water, steam, or liquid geysers, it spouts forcefully upward into the air.

examples.en: Water geysered out of the broken pipe, flooding the entire street within minutes.
examples.zh: 水从破裂的管道中如间歇泉般喷涌而出，几分钟内就淹没了整条街。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 geyser 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使卷入，使陷入（纷争或困境）；牵连
lemmas.def_en: [T] (+ in/with) (often passive) To involve someone deeply in an argument, conflict, or difficult situation.

examples.en: He tried to stay neutral, but he was soon embroiled in the bitter dispute.
examples.zh: 他试图保持中立，但很快就卷入了这场激烈的纷争之中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 embroil 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 费用, 经费, 支出
lemmas.def_en: the act of spending or disbursing money

examples.en: The new project requires a significant initial outlay of capital for raw materials.
examples.zh: 这个新项目需要一大笔初始资金支出来采购原材料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outlay 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a long fishing line with many shorter lines and hooks attached to it (usually suspended between buoys)

examples.en: The fishermen slowly hauled the heavy trawl back onto the deck after hours.
examples.zh: 数小时后，渔民们慢慢将沉重的拖网拉回到甲板上。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To search thoroughly through a large amount of information, documents, or places in order to find something. 2. To fish by pulling a large net along the seabed.

examples.en: The fishermen slowly hauled the heavy trawl back onto the deck after hours.
examples.zh: 数小时后，渔民们慢慢将沉重的拖网拉回到甲板上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trawl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 私奔（尤指未经父母同意秘密结婚）；逃跑，潜逃
lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ with) To run away secretly in order to get married, especially without parental consent.

examples.en: Knowing their parents would disapprove, the young couple decided to elope to Scotland.
examples.zh: 知道父母会反对，这对年轻情侣决定私奔去苏格兰。

lemmas.def_en: the act of running away with a lover (usually to get married)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 elope 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 字面, 字体, 印出的文字(或图样)
lemmas.def_en: a specific size and style of type within a type family

examples.en: The graphic designer selected a clean modern typeface for the new company logo.
examples.zh: 平面设计师为公司的新标志选择了一款干净现代的字体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 typeface 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To reduce speed; to slow down, or cause a vehicle or process to slow down.

examples.en: You need to decelerate gradually as you approach the sharp curve ahead.
examples.zh: 接近前方急转弯时，你需要逐渐减速。

lemmas.def_en: a decrease in rate of change

examples.en: the deceleration of the arms race

family_guide.root_logic: 以 decelerate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to become liquid, or to turn a solid or gas into a liquid by heating, pressure, or condensation

examples.en: Extreme heat will liquefy the solid plastic blocks in just a few minutes.
examples.zh: 极高的温度会在短短几分钟内使坚硬的塑料块液化。

lemmas.def_zh: 液化, 溶解, 液化作用
lemmas.def_en: the conversion of a solid or a gas into a liquid

examples.en: The massive earthquake triggered severe soil liquefaction, causing buildings to tilt dangerously.
examples.zh: 强烈地震引发了严重的土壤液化，导致建筑物危险地倾斜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 liquefy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an ornamental sunken panel in a ceiling or dome

examples.en: The continuous drop in tourism revenue has severely depleted the city coffers.
examples.zh: 旅游收入的持续下降严重耗尽了该市的金库。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coffer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 火蜥蜴, 火怪, 耐火的人
lemmas.def_en: any of various typically terrestrial amphibians that resemble lizards and that return to water only to breed

examples.en: A tiny spotted salamander crawled slowly beneath the damp rotting log in silence.
examples.zh: 一只小小的斑点火蜥蜴在潮湿腐烂的原木下静静地缓慢爬行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 salamander 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 音系学, 历时音系学
lemmas.def_en: the study of the sound system of a given language and the analysis and classification of its phonemes

examples.en: The introductory course explores the phonology and sound systems of various world languages.
examples.zh: 这门入门课程探讨了世界各种语言的音系学和语音系统。

lemmas.def_zh: 音位学的, 音韵学的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to phonology

examples.en: the phonological component of language

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phonology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 张贴公告于，张贴海报公布；举告示牌抗议
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To post notices or posters in, on, or around a place. 2. [T] To announce, advertise, or protest against something by means of placards.

examples.en: Activists placarded the city walls with posters demanding immediate action on climate change.
examples.zh: 活动人士在城墙上张贴海报，要求就气候变化立即采取行动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 placard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various types of fold formed by doubling fabric back upon itself and then pressing or stitching into shape

examples.en: She ironed each pleat of her skirt carefully before attending the ceremony.
examples.zh: 在参加典礼之前，她仔细熨烫了裙子上的每一个褶子。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To fold cloth or paper into neat, flat, parallel pleats and press or sew them in place.

examples.en: She ironed each pleat of her skirt carefully before attending the ceremony.
examples.zh: 在参加典礼之前，她仔细熨烫了裙子上的每一个褶子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pleat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 微型集成电路片, 微片, 芯片
lemmas.def_en: electronic equipment consisting of a small crystal of a silicon semiconductor fabricated to carry out a number of electronic functions in an integrated circuit

examples.en: Modern vehicles rely on dozens of microchips to control essential safety features smoothly.
examples.zh: 现代汽车依靠数十个芯片来平稳控制关键的安全功能。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 microchip 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 贴边, 鞭痕, 殴打
lemmas.def_en: a raised mark on the skin (as produced by the blow of a whip); characteristic of many allergic reactions

examples.en: The harsh blow left a painful red welt across his right arm.
examples.zh: 那记重击在他右臂上留下一道疼痛的红肿鞭痕。

lemmas.def_zh: 鞭打，痛打（在皮肤上打出红肿条痕）；给……加贴边
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. to beat heavily, leaving raised red marks on the skin. 2. to sew a reinforcing strip (welt) onto a shoe or garment.

examples.en: The harsh blow left a painful red welt across his right arm.
examples.zh: 那记重击在他右臂上留下一道疼痛的红肿鞭痕。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 welt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 尖旗, 三角旗, 三角锦旗, 三角信号旗
lemmas.def_en: the award given to the champion

examples.en: Bright triangular pennants fluttered in the breeze along the edge of the roof.
examples.zh: 明亮的三角旗在屋顶边缘迎风飘扬。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pennant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the longest division of geological time

examples.en: These deep limestone canyons were carved by flowing river water over many eons.
examples.zh: 这些深邃的石灰岩峡谷是河水历经万古岁月冲刷而成的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 回答, 反扑, 退还
lemmas.def_en: a commercial bribe paid by a seller to a purchasing agent in order to induce the agent to enter into the transaction

examples.en: The corrupt official was arrested for accepting a massive kickback from the contractor.
examples.zh: 这名腐败官员因收受承包商的巨额回扣而被逮捕。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kickback 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a holder with sockets for candles

examples.en: A tall brass candlestick stood in the center of the wooden dining table.
examples.zh: 一个高大的黄铜蜡烛架立在木制餐桌的中央。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 candlestick 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: firework consisting of a small explosive charge and fuse in a heavy paper casing

examples.en: Children lit a firecracker in the courtyard to celebrate the new year.
examples.zh: 孩子们在院子里点燃鞭炮庆祝新年。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 firecracker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: showing the cunning or ingenuity or wickedness typical of a devil

examples.en: The villain devised a diabolical plot to take control of the city.
examples.zh: 反派策划了一个极其邪恶的阴谋来控制这座城市。

lemmas.def_en: as a devil; in an evil manner

examples.en: his writing could be diabolically satiric

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diabolical 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a punctuation mark (-) used between parts of a compound word or between the syllables of a word when the word is divided at the end of a line of text

examples.en: You need to insert a hyphen between these two words to avoid confusion.
examples.zh: 你需要在两词之间加一个连字符以避免混淆。

lemmas.def_en: division of a word especially at the end of a line on a page

lemmas.def_zh: 用连字符连接（单词或音节）
lemmas.def_en: [T] To join words or syllables together using a hyphen (-); hyphenate.

examples.en: You need to insert a hyphen between these two words to avoid confusion.
examples.zh: 你需要在两词之间加一个连字符以避免混淆。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To connect two words or parts of a word with a hyphen.

examples.en: hyphenate these words and names

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hyphen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I] to move forward by making sharp, alternating turns to the left and right

examples.en: The mountain trail zigzags sharply up the steep and rocky slope.
examples.zh: 山间小道曲折穿行在陡峭多石的斜坡上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 zigzag 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 传统主义者, 因循守旧者
lemmas.def_en: one who adheres to traditional views

examples.en: As a strict traditionalist, he prefers handwritten letters over digital messages.
examples.zh: 作为严格的传统主义者，他更喜欢手写信而非电子消息。

lemmas.def_en: strict adherence to traditional methods or teachings

examples.en: The rural village retains its cultural traditionalism despite rapid modern urban development.
examples.zh: 尽管现代城市快速发展，这个乡村小镇仍保留着文化传统主义。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 traditionalist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or resembling a square

examples.en: The math teacher asked the students to solve the difficult quadratic equation.
examples.zh: 数学老师要求学生们解出这道复杂的二次方程。

lemmas.def_en: an equation in which the highest power of an unknown quantity is a square

examples.en: The math teacher asked the students to solve the difficult quadratic equation.
examples.zh: 数学老师要求学生们解出这道复杂的二次方程。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quadratic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 分光术, 光谱测定法
lemmas.def_en: the use of spectroscopes to analyze spectra

examples.en: Mass spectrometry was used to analyze the chemical composition of the unknown substance.
examples.zh: 质谱分析法被用于分析该未知物质的化学成分。

lemmas.def_en: spectroscope for obtaining a mass spectrum by deflecting ions into a thin slit and measuring the ion current with an electrometer

examples.en: The laboratory uses a spectrometer to analyze the chemical composition of stars.
examples.zh: 该实验室使用分光计来分析恒星的化学成分。

lemmas.def_zh: 光谱测定的, 度谱的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or involving spectrometry

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spectrometry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a name given to a product or service

examples.en: The luxury car marque is known worldwide for its exceptional engineering standards.
examples.zh: 该豪车品牌以其卓越的工程水准闻名世界。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 marque 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: harsh or corrosive in tone

examples.en: Workers must wear protective gloves when handling this extremely caustic chemical substance.
examples.zh: 工人在处理这种强腐蚀性化学物质时必须佩戴防护手套。

lemmas.def_zh: 腐蚀地, 讥讽地, 挖苦地
lemmas.def_en: in a caustic vitriolic manner

examples.en: he addressed her caustically

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caustic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the cry made by sheep

examples.en: The lost lamb let out a pitiful baa across the open field.
examples.zh: 迷路的小羊在开阔的田野上发出可怜的咩咩叫声。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] When a sheep or lamb baas, it makes its characteristic bleating cry.

examples.en: The lost lamb let out a pitiful baa across the open field.
examples.zh: 迷路的小羊在开阔的田野上发出可怜的咩咩叫声。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 baa 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an abnormal backward flow of body fluids

examples.en: He drinks herbal tea before bedtime to prevent painful symptoms of acid reflux.
examples.zh: 他睡前喝草本茶以预防痛苦的胃酸倒流症状。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reflux 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: abnormal loss of bony tissue resulting in fragile porous bones attributable to a lack of calcium; most common in postmenopausal women

examples.en: Regular exercise and calcium intake can significantly reduce the risk of osteoporosis.
examples.zh: 规律运动和补充钙质可显著降低骨质疏松的风险。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 osteoporosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 爷爷, 老太爷, 外公
lemmas.def_en: the father of your father or mother

examples.en: My grandad loves sharing fascinating stories about his youth in the countryside.
examples.zh: 我爷爷喜欢分享他年轻时在乡村的精彩故事。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grandad 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the best of its kind

examples.en: The prime minister gave the company primo seats at the cultural festival.
examples.zh: 首相在文化节上为该公司安排了最顶级的席位。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 primo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无比的, 不能比较的
lemmas.def_en: such that comparison is impossible; unsuitable for comparison or lacking features that can be compared

examples.en: Her voice possessed an incomparable beauty that moved the entire audience to tears.
examples.zh: 她的嗓音拥有无与伦比的美感，令全场观众感动落泪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 incomparable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a massive inexorable force that seems to crush everything in its way

examples.en: The tech giant has become an unstoppable juggernaut in the global market.
examples.zh: 这家科技巨头已成为全球市场上势不可挡的庞然大物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 juggernaut 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: very slow in tempo and broad in manner

examples.en: The orchestra opened the second movement with a solemn and largo tempo.
examples.zh: 管弦乐团以庄严而缓慢的节拍开启了第二乐章。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 largo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: fine ravellings of cotton or linen fibers

examples.en: She used a sticky roller to remove stubborn lint from her black coat.
examples.zh: 她用粘毛滚筒清理了黑外套上顽固的织物碎屑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lint 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: fishes having large mouths with a wormlike filament attached for luring prey

examples.en: We bought several popular chocolate snacks produced by Lotte at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 我们在超市买了几款乐天生产的热门巧克力零食。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lotte 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: hard dark reddish wood of a rosewood tree having a strongly marked grain; used in cabinetwork

examples.en: The antique dining table was carefully crafted from solid, high-quality rosewood.
examples.zh: 这张古董餐桌是用坚固优质的红木精心制作的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rosewood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: elegant and sumptuous

examples.en: The boutique hotel offers a luxe ambiance with marble bathrooms and silk sheets.
examples.zh: 这家精品酒店拥有大理石浴室和真丝床单，格调奢华。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 luxe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: shrubby plant with aromatic greyish-green leaves used as a cooking herb

examples.en: Ramona packed her bags quietly before anyone else woke up in the morning.
examples.zh: 拉蒙纳清晨在其他人醒来前悄悄收拾好了行李。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ramona 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用小书写体的, 小写字的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a small cursive script developed from uncial; 7th to 9th centuries

examples.en: The text was written in a minuscule script that was nearly impossible to read.
examples.zh: 文本是用极小的字体书写的，几乎无法辨认。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 minuscule 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: toward the outside

examples.en: The old wooden door opened outwards into the dimly lit garden path.
examples.zh: 那扇旧木门向外打开，通向昏暗的花园小径。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outwards 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a flexible board for jumping upward

examples.en: The regional competition served as a valuable springboard for her professional career.
examples.zh: 这次地区比赛成为她职业生涯的宝贵跳板。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 springboard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the most recent period of the Stone Age (following the mesolithic)

examples.en: Archaeologists uncovered fascinating Neolithic stone tools during the summer excavation project.
examples.zh: 考古学家在夏季发掘项目中发现了令人着迷的新石器时代石器。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 neolithic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: common sense

examples.en: He showed great practical nous by fixing the engine with basic tools.
examples.zh: 他用简易工具修好了引擎，展现出极强的实际常识。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: leaf or strip from a leaf of the talipot palm used in India for writing paper

examples.en: The museum preserves ancient Buddhist texts carefully inscribed on dried ola leaves.
examples.zh: 博物馆保存着用贝多罗树叶精心刻写的古老佛教文献。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ola 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (the feminine of raja) a Hindu princess or the wife of a raja

examples.en: The rani welcomed foreign dignitaries with great elegance inside the grand palace.
examples.zh: 王妃在宏伟的宫殿内极其优雅地接见了外国贵宾。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rani 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 负担, 责任, 义务, 过失, 耻辱
lemmas.def_en: an onerous or difficult concern

examples.en: The onus is on the prosecution to prove the defendant's guilt beyond doubt.
examples.zh: 举证证明被告有罪的责任在于控方。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 onus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of genetics that studies organisms in terms of their genomes (their full DNA sequences)

examples.en: Recent advances in genomics have revolutionized our understanding of inherited rare diseases.
examples.zh: 基因组学的最新进展彻底改变了我们对罕见遗传病的理解。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 genomics 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a type of cell death in which the cell uses specialized cellular machinery to kill itself; a cell suicide mechanism that enables metazoans to control cell number and eliminate cells that threaten the animal's survival

examples.en: Defects in the regulation of apoptosis can lead to uncontrolled cell proliferation.
examples.zh: 细胞凋亡调控的缺陷会导致细胞不受控制地增殖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 apoptosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an abnormal state in which the normal flow of a liquid (such as blood) is slowed or stopped

examples.en: The long period of political stasis finally ended after the national elections.
examples.zh: 长期的政治停滞状态在全国大选后终于结束了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stasis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 神秘的, 晦涩难解的
lemmas.def_en: requiring secret or mysterious knowledge

examples.en: He spent decades deciphering the arcane rules of medieval legal manuscripts.
examples.zh: 他花了数十年时间破译中世纪法律手稿中晦涩难懂的规则。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arcane 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a shop where men can get their hair cut

examples.en: Old men gathered at the corner barbershop to discuss the morning news.
examples.zh: 老人们聚集在街角的理发店里讨论早间新闻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 barbershop 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to the adrenal glands or their secretions

examples.en: Stress triggers the adrenal glands to release adrenaline into the bloodstream rapidly.
examples.zh: 压力会促使肾上腺迅速向血液中释放肾上腺素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 adrenal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 向后, 朝后, 突然, 船顶风地
lemmas.def_en: having the wind against the forward side of the sails

examples.en: I was taken aback by her sudden decision to quit her stable job.

lemmas.def_zh: 网络空间；虚拟信息空间

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to ethnography

examples.en: The coroner confirmed that the victim died of asphyxia from smoke inhalation.
examples.zh: 验尸官证实受害者死于吸入浓烟导致的窒息。

lemmas.def_en: the condition of being deprived of oxygen (as by having breathing stopped)

examples.en: asphyxiation is sometimes used as a form of torture

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To kill, die, or become unconscious from being deprived of air or unable to breathe.

examples.en: Othello smothered Desdemona with a pillow
The child suffocated herself with a plastic bag that the parents had left on the floor

family_guide.root_logic: 以 asphyxia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a negatively charged ion

examples.en: When a neutral atom gains an extra electron, it becomes an anion.
examples.zh: 当中性原子获得额外电子时，它就会变成阴离子。

lemmas.def_en: a class of synthetic detergents in which the molecules do not ionize in aqueous solutions

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a slender tube inserted inside a tubular body part (as a blood vessel) to provide support during and after surgical anastomosis

examples.en: The cardiac surgeon successfully inserted a tiny metal stent into the artery.
examples.zh: 心脏外科医生成功将一个微型金属支架植入了动脉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 死水, 滞水, 停滞, 回水
lemmas.def_en: a body of water that was created by a flood or tide or by being held or forced back by a dam

examples.en: The once-sleepy rural backwater developed rapidly after the new highway opened.
examples.zh: 在这个曾经沉寂闭塞的偏远之地，新公路开通后迅速发展起来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 backwater 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 深不可测的, 无底的
lemmas.def_en: very great; limitless

examples.en: The team suffered an abysmal defeat after making countless basic defensive mistakes.
examples.zh: 该队在犯下无数低级防守失误后遭遇惨败。

lemmas.def_zh: 极糟地; 可怕地; 完全地; 极端地
lemmas.def_en: in a terrible manner

examples.en: she sings terribly

family_guide.root_logic: 以 abysmal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in an uncontrolled manner

examples.en: She began laughing uncontrollably at the absurd situation unfolding before her.
examples.zh: 面对眼前展开的荒诞一幕，她忍不住放声大笑起来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 uncontrollably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （早餐营养食品）格兰诺拉燕麦卷
lemmas.def_en: cereal made of especially rolled oats with dried fruits and nuts and honey or brown sugar

examples.en: She topped her morning bowl of fresh yogurt with crunchy organic granola.
examples.zh: 她在早晨的新鲜酸奶上撒了些酥脆的有机格兰诺拉麦片。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 granola 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 血淋淋的, 满是血的, 血污的
lemmas.def_en: covered with blood

examples.en: He covered his eyes to avoid seeing the gory details of the accident.
examples.zh: 他捂住双眼，不忍直视事故现场血淋淋的细节。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who hunts game

examples.en: The skilled huntsman followed the deer tracks silently through the dense woods.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的猎人悄无声息地穿过密林，追踪鹿的足迹。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 huntsman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: subnormal body temperature

examples.en: The rescued hikers were treated immediately for severe hypothermia and exhaustion.
examples.zh: 获救的徒步旅行者因严重体温过低和力竭立即接受了治疗。

lemmas.def_zh: 低体温的, 体温过低的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or affected by hypothermia

examples.en: Rescue workers wrapped the hypothermic hiker in thick blankets to restore warmth.
examples.zh: 救援人员用厚毛毯裹住体温过低的徒步者以帮他回温。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hypothermia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 向陆的, 陆上的, 在国内的
lemmas.def_en: (of winds) coming from the sea toward the land

examples.en: The government heavily invested in developing new onshore wind farms this year.
examples.zh: 政府今年投入巨资开发新的陆上风电场。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 onshore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 在（话语或文章中）大量穿插，缀满；在（瘦肉）中夹入肥肉膘
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To embellish or fill speech or writing abundantly with particular words, quotations, or references. 2. (cooking) To insert strips of fat into lean meat before cooking.

examples.en: The author tended to lard his essays with obscure and archaic words.
examples.zh: 该作者往往会在他的文章中夹杂一些晦涩古旧的词汇。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 套索, 束缚, 陷阱
lemmas.def_en: a trap for birds or small mammals; often has a slip noose

examples.en: The hangman carefully adjusted the rough hemp noose around the criminal's neck.
examples.zh: 刽子手小心地将粗麻套索套在罪犯的脖子上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 noose 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of a ship or plane) sideways drift

examples.en: The flexible project deadline gave the creative team some much-needed leeway.
examples.zh: 弹性的项目截止日期为创意团队提供了急需的回旋余地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leeway 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an elf in fairy stories who sprinkles sand in children's eyes to make them sleepy

examples.en: The tired toddler finally fell asleep when the mythical sandman arrived.
examples.zh: 当传说中的睡魔降临时，疲倦的幼童终于睡着了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sandman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] (pl.mademoiselles, mesdemoiselles )小姐(相当于英语Miss , 单数略为Mlle, 复数略为Mlles), [英]法国女(家庭)教师
lemmas.def_en: small silvery drumfish often mistaken for white perch; found along coasts of United States from New York to Mexico

examples.en: The polite waiter bowed slightly and asked mademoiselle what she wished to order.
examples.zh: 礼貌的服务员微微鞠躬，询问小姐想点些什么。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mademoiselle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 仓库, 库存, 储备, 保留剧目轮演
lemmas.def_en: a storehouse where a stock of things is kept

examples.en: The local theater company maintains an impressive repertory of classic Shakespearean plays.
examples.zh: 这家当地剧团保留了令人印象深刻的莎士比亚经典剧目。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 repertory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a light volatile flammable poisonous liquid alcohol; used as an antifreeze and solvent and fuel and as a denaturant for ethyl alcohol

examples.en: Racing cars sometimes use pure methanol as fuel to achieve higher engine performance.
examples.zh: 赛车有时使用纯甲醇作为燃料，以获得更高的发动机性能。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 methanol 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various small-grained annual cereal and forage grasses of the genera Panicum, Echinochloa, Setaria, Sorghum, and Eleusine

examples.en: Farmers in the arid northern region rely heavily on drought-resistant millet crops.
examples.zh: 干旱北方地区的农民非常依赖抗旱的粟米作物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 millet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: extinct flightless bird of New Zealand

examples.en: The giant moa was a flightless bird native to ancient New Zealand forests.
examples.zh: 巨型恐鸟是曾栖息于古代新西兰森林中的一种不会飞的鸟。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 moa 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: soft suede glove leather from goatskin

examples.en: She stopped at the corner cafe every morning to grab an iced mocha.
examples.zh: 她每天早晨都会在街角咖啡馆停下来买一杯冰摩卡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mocha 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: long-tailed grey-and-white songbird of the southern United States able to mimic songs of other birds

examples.en: A northern mockingbird perched on the oak branch, mimicking diverse bird calls effortlessly.
examples.zh: 一只北方嘲鸫栖息在橡树枝上，轻松自如地模仿着各种鸟鸣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mockingbird 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 超量毁伤, 过度杀伤威力

examples.en: Bringing a massive sledgehammer just to crack a tiny walnut is absolute overkill.
examples.zh: 仅仅为了敲开一个小核桃就拿出一把大铁锤完全是大材小用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overkill 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: incongruous;inviting ridicule

examples.en: The tired speaker rambled on, uttering several completely nonsensical arguments before stopping.
examples.zh: 疲惫的发言人喋喋不休，在停下来之前发表了好几个完全荒谬的论点。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nonsensical 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: occurring immediately after birth

examples.en: New mothers often receive specialized care to cope with physical and postpartum depression.
examples.zh: 新晋母亲通常会接受专业护理，以应对身体恢复及产后抑郁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 postpartum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （爱尔兰和苏格兰传说中）预告死亡的女妖精
lemmas.def_en: (Irish folklore) a female spirit who wails to warn of impending death

examples.en: The fierce midnight wind howled outside like a wailing banshee in the darkness.
examples.zh: 深夜狂暴的寒风在黑暗中呼啸，宛如报丧女妖的哀嚎。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 banshee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 男中音, 男中音歌手, 低音铜管乐器

examples.zh: 他醇厚的男中音在音乐厅的音响环境中深深回荡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 baritone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the country where you were born

examples.en: The brave soldiers pledged their lives to defend the borders of their beloved fatherland.
examples.zh: 英勇的士兵们誓死保卫他们深爱的祖国边疆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fatherland 为核心的派生词族。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 athleticism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: used as a Hindi courtesy title; equivalent to English `Mr'

examples.zh: 英国办事员在会议期间礼貌地称呼那位受人尊敬的印度官员为巴布先生。

lemmas.def_en: fortification consisting of a strong fence made of stakes driven into the ground

family_guide.root_logic: 以 palisade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 舰长的职位, 大将的才略, 舰长的衔头

examples.en: Under his inspiring captaincy, the struggling football team won their first major championship title.
examples.zh: 在他鼓舞人心的队长领导下，这支陷入困境的足球队赢得了首个重要冠军头衔。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 captaincy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a binary compound of carbon with a more electropositive element

examples.en: Industrial factories frequently use durable carbide cutting tools to slice through solid steel plates.
examples.zh: 工业工厂经常使用耐用的碳化物切削工具来切割坚固的钢板。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 carbide 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 胭脂红的, 洋红色的, 深红色的

examples.zh: 一只训练有素的柯利牧羊犬熟练地引着分散的羊群穿过草山。

examples.zh: 现代消费主义往往鼓励人们购买自己既不需要也不真正想要的物品。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (archaic or literary) To behave in a reckless, unrestrained, or playful way.

examples.zh: 无忧无虑的孩子们整个下午都在浅水河里嬉戏打闹。

lemmas.def_en: in a wanton manner

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 有意漠视, 胡乱, 放纵

examples.en: she danced with abandon

lemmas.def_zh: 用（北美印第安）战斧砍杀

examples.zh: 战士从阴影中跃出，用战斧将敌人的盾牌利落地劈成两半。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tomahawk 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 由于内置了陀螺仪，无人机在强风中仍能保持完全稳定。

lemmas.def_en: a storm with widespread snowfall accompanied by strong winds

examples.zh: 一场突如其来的暴风雪在一夜之间让城市街道覆上了厚厚的白雪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snowstorm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 猛烈的攻击/谴责, 连珠炮似的攻讦/谴责, 舷侧
lemmas.def_en: an advertisement (usually printed on a page or in a leaflet) intended for wide distribution

examples.zh: 参议员今天上午对提议的税收改革发起了猛烈抨击。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (chiefly North American) to crash directly into the side of another vehicle.

examples.en: The senator launched a fierce broadside against the proposed tax reforms this morning.
examples.zh: 参议员今天上午对提议的税收改革发起了猛烈抨击。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 broadside 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: duct through which urine is discharged in most mammals and which serves as the male genital duct

examples.zh: 医生解释说，细菌感染导致他的尿道产生了疼痛。

lemmas.def_en: an organism with cells characteristic of all life forms except primitive microorganisms such as bacteria; i.e. an organism with `good' or membrane-bound nuclei in its cells

examples.zh: 与简单的细菌不同，每个真核生物都将遗传物质储存在清晰的细胞核内。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eukaryote 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several eruptive skin diseases characterized by hard thick lesions grouped together and resembling lichens growing on rocks

examples.en: Patches of colorful lichen cling stubbornly to the cold, damp mountain rocks.
examples.zh: 斑斓的地衣顽强地附着在阴冷潮湿的山石上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lichen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a percussion instrument consisting of a concave brass disk; makes a loud crashing sound when hit with a drumstick or when two are struck together

examples.en: The energetic drummer hit the brass cymbal to emphasize the dramatic climax.
examples.zh: 充满活力的鼓手重击铜钹，以烘托充满戏剧性的高潮。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cymbal 为核心的派生词族。

examples.en: Campers must completely douse the campfire with water before heading to sleep.
examples.zh: 露营者睡觉前必须用水将营火彻底浇灭。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 douse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 遗迹, 痕迹, 残余, 丝毫, 退化的器官

examples.en: Not a single vestige of the ancient settlement remained after the massive flood.
examples.zh: 特大洪水过后，这个古老定居点连一丝痕迹都没留下。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vestige 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any workplace where people are very busy

examples.zh: 嗡嗡作响的蜂箱里挤满了成千上万只酿造甜蜜的勤劳工蜂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 beehive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 邦戈羚羊(产于非洲), 小手鼓

lemmas.def_en: tediously repetitious or lacking in variety

lemmas.def_en: in a monotonous manner
