family_guide.root_logic: 以 overdraft 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a porch along the outside of a building (sometimes partly enclosed)

examples.en: We spent the warm summer evening sipping iced tea on the spacious front veranda.
examples.zh: 我们在宽敞的前阳台上喝着冰茶，度过了温暖的夏夜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 veranda 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （加水等）使复原，使恢复原状；重组，重建
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To restore dried or condensed food or drink to its original liquid or solid form by adding water. 2. [T] To reorganize, reconstruct, or re-establish an organization or system.

examples.en: You can easily reconstitute the powdered soup mix by adding two cups of boiling water.
examples.zh: 加入两杯开水，你就能轻松将这种汤料粉冲调复原。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reconstitute 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To touch, stroke, or handle someone or something gently and affectionately, often in a sexual way.

examples.en: She sat quietly on the sofa and began to gently fondle the sleeping kitten.
examples.zh: 她静静地坐在沙发上，开始温柔地抚摩那只熟睡的小猫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fondle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: either of two Welsh breeds of long-bodied short-legged dogs with erect ears and a fox-like head

examples.en: The playful corgi ran happily across the lawn, chasing a yellow tennis ball.
examples.zh: 那只顽皮的柯基犬在草坪上欢快地奔跑，追逐着一个黄色网球。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 corgi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a positively charged electrode by which electrons leave an electrical device

examples.en: In this battery cell, electrons flow naturally from the negative anode to the cathode.
examples.zh: 在这个电池单元中，电子自然地从负极阳极流向阴极。

lemmas.def_en: of or at or relating to an anode

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anode 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 伪造的, 不诚实的, 卑鄙的, 险恶的
lemmas.def_en: expressive of contempt

examples.en: She was deeply hurt by his snide remarks regarding her newly published novel.
examples.zh: 他对她新出版的小说所作的冷嘲热讽让她深受伤害。

lemmas.def_en: with a sneer; in an uncomplimentary sneering manner

examples.en: `I don't believe in these customs,' he said sneeringly

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snide 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: showing pensive sadness

examples.en: He cast a wistful look at the old photographs of his childhood hometown.
examples.zh: 他带着依依不舍的怀念神情，凝视着童年故乡的老照片。

lemmas.def_en: in a wistful manner

examples.en: his sister would have looked beautiful in that dress, he thought wistfully, just like an angel

lemmas.def_zh: 惆怅; 渴望; 思念
lemmas.def_en: a sadly pensive longing

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wistful 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tropical American evergreen tree bearing kidney-shaped nuts that are edible only when roasted

examples.en: He bought a bag of roasted cashew nuts as a healthy afternoon snack.
examples.zh: 他买了一袋烤腰果，当作健康的下午茶点心。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cashew 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a space that is contained within another space

examples.en: The mathematician proved that the set of vectors forms a valid subspace here.
examples.zh: 数学家证明了这组向量在此处构成了一个有效的子空间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subspace 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to ancient Philistia or its culture or its people

examples.en: His philistine attitude toward contemporary art annoyed the talented young painters at the gallery.
examples.zh: 他对当代艺术粗俗鄙陋的态度惹恼了画廊里才华横溢的年轻画家们。

lemmas.def_zh: 庸人, 门外汉, 仇敌, 俗气的人
lemmas.def_en: a person who is uninterested in intellectual pursuits

examples.en: He mocked modern art, dismissing it like an uncultured philistine.
examples.zh: 他嘲弄现代艺术，像个缺乏教养的庸人一样不屑一顾。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 philistine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an assumption on which rests the validity or effect of something else

examples.en: Mutual trust is an essential precondition for lasting business partnerships.
examples.zh: 相互信任是建立持久商业合作关系的必要前提。

lemmas.def_zh: 预先调整，预先训练（使其适应某种状态）；预先设定条件
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To train, condition, or prepare someone or something in advance to behave or react in a desired way.

examples.en: Mutual trust is an essential precondition for lasting business partnerships.
examples.zh: 相互信任是建立持久商业合作关系的必要前提。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 precondition 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 重新解释，作出新理解，重新诠释
lemmas.def_en: [T] To understand or explain a text, concept, or event in a new or different way.

examples.en: The young director decided to reinterpret the classic Shakespearean tragedy.
examples.zh: 这位年轻导演决定重新诠释这部经典的莎士比亚悲剧。

lemmas.def_zh: 重新解释, 纠正性说明
lemmas.def_en: a new or different meaning

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reinterpret 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To twist or bend out of its normal shape, or cause the face or body to twist in an unnatural way.

examples.en: His face began to contort with extreme pain and frustration.
examples.zh: 因极度痛苦与挫败，他的面容开始扭曲起来。

lemmas.def_zh: 善作柔体表演的杂技演员
lemmas.def_en: an acrobat able to twist into unusual positions

lemmas.def_zh: 扭弯, 扭歪, 曲解
lemmas.def_en: the act of twisting or deforming the shape of something (e.g., yourself)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 contort 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 强忍怒火，生闷气；翻滚，沸腾
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ with) To feel intensely angry while keeping the emotion suppressed. 2. [I] (of a liquid) To bubble, boil, or churn violently.

examples.en: She tried to look calm, but inwardly she began to seethe.
examples.zh: 她极力保持镇静，但内心却已怒火中烧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seethe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small industrial vehicle with a power operated forked platform in front that can be inserted under loads to lift and move them

examples.en: The warehouse worker used a forklift to move the heavy pallets.
examples.zh: 仓库工人使用叉车搬运沉重的托盘。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 forklift 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a fight involving shooting small arms with the intent to kill or frighten

examples.en: The police engaged in a fierce gunfight with the armed robbers.
examples.zh: 警方与持枪劫匪展开了一场激烈的枪战。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gunfight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有魄力的, 有进取心的, 有事业心的
lemmas.def_en: marked by imagination, initiative, and readiness to undertake new projects

examples.en: An enterprising student started a thriving delivery business on campus.
examples.zh: 一名有进取心的学生在校园里开创了繁荣的配送业务。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 enterprising 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: plant bearing very hot and finely tapering long peppers; usually red

examples.en: Sprinkle a pinch of cayenne pepper to add extra heat to the soup.
examples.zh: 撒入一小撮辣椒粉，给汤增添些许辣味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cayenne 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 气密的, 不透气的, 无懈可击的
lemmas.def_en: having no weak points

examples.en: Store the coffee beans in an airtight container to keep them fresh.
examples.zh: 将咖啡豆存放在密封容器中以保持新鲜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 airtight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: being up to particular standard or level especially in being up to date in knowledge

examples.en: Professionals must stay abreast of the latest developments in modern technology.
examples.zh: 专业人士必须跟上现代技术的最新发展步伐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 abreast 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several cultivated grapevines that produce sweet white grapes

examples.en: They spent a pleasant weekend exploring historical sites around Muscat.
examples.zh: 他们在马斯喀特度过了一个愉快的周末，探索历史古迹。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 muscat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 狂文, 铺张华丽的表演, 狂行, 狂言, 狂剧, 狂曲, 狂诗
lemmas.def_en: any lavishly staged or spectacular entertainment

examples.en: The city hosted a musical extravaganza that attracted thousands of tourists.
examples.zh: 该市举办了一场吸引数千名游客的盛大音乐演出。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 extravaganza 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the Sabbath

examples.en: The professor is taking a sabbatical leave to complete his novel.
examples.zh: 这位教授正在休学术年假，以完成他的小说创作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sabbatical 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: informal term for vacation

examples.en: She spent her summer vac relaxing on a remote tropical island.
examples.zh: 她在遥远的热带岛屿上度过了轻松的暑假。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vac 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: residue from making butter from sour raw milk; or pasteurized milk curdled by adding a culture

examples.en: Adding cold buttermilk makes the homemade pancakes fluffy and tender.
examples.zh: 加入冷酪乳能让自制的煎饼松软可口。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 buttermilk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 脐, 肚脐, 中央, 中心
lemmas.def_en: a scar where the umbilical cord was attached

examples.en: The dancer wore a cropped top that exposed her navel.
examples.zh: 舞者穿了一件露脐短上衣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 navel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To reject an offer, request, or friendly approach abruptly and unkindly.

examples.en: The committee chose to rebuff his unexpected proposal for reform.
examples.zh: 委员会决定断然拒绝他提出的意外改革提案。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rebuff 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 商人, 办理实务的人, 经商者
lemmas.def_en: a female businessperson

examples.en: She is a successful businesswoman managing multiple international tech companies.
examples.zh: 她是一位管理着多家国际科技公司的成功女商人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 businesswoman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: acid or granitic glass formed by the rapid cooling of lava without crystallization; usually dark, but transparent in thin pieces

examples.en: Ancient craftspeople carved sharp arrowheads from dark, glassy obsidian.
examples.zh: 古代工匠用深色玻璃质黑曜石雕刻锋利的箭头。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 obsidian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 干涸沟壑, 旱谷, 小河
lemmas.def_en: a stream or brook

examples.en: Sudden desert rain quickly turned the dry arroyo into a torrent.
examples.zh: 沙漠中的暴雨迅速将干涸的旱谷变成了汹涌的急流。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arroyo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无定形的, 无组织的
lemmas.def_en: having no definite form or distinct shape

examples.en: The artist molded the amorphous lump of clay into a delicate human face.
examples.zh: 艺术家将那一团无定形的黏土塑造成了一张精致的人脸。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amorphous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 多用途的, 通用的, 多功能的
lemmas.def_en: having multiple uses

examples.en: This multipurpose tool includes a knife, a screwdriver, and a bottle opener.
examples.zh: 这款多功能工具包含一把小刀、一个螺丝刀和一个开瓶器。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 multipurpose 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 修道院附属的教堂, 大教堂
lemmas.def_en: any of certain cathedrals and large churches; originally connected to a monastery

examples.en: The bells of the ancient minster chimed across the town every morning.
examples.zh: 古老大教堂的钟声每天清晨在整个小镇上空回荡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 minster 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a diacritical mark (-) placed above a vowel to indicate a long sound

examples.en: In many dictionaries, a macron over a vowel indicates a long sound.
examples.zh: 在许多词典中，元音字母上方的长音符号表示长元音。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 macron 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 高射炮, 对空炮火, 广告, 宣传
lemmas.def_en: a slick spokesperson who can turn any criticism to the advantage of their employer

examples.en: The company hired an experienced flack to manage the aggressive media inquiries.
examples.zh: 该公司聘请了一位经验丰富的公关人员来应对激烈的媒体质询。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flack 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 老年病学的, 衰老的, 老年的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the aged

examples.en: The hospital recently opened a new geriatric ward for elderly heart patients.
examples.zh: 这家医院最近为老年心脏病患者开设了一个新的老年病房。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of medical science that deals with diseases and problems specific to old people

examples.en: The hospital recently opened a specialized department focusing strictly on modern geriatrics.
examples.zh: 这家医院最近开设了一个专注于现代老年医学的专科部门。

lemmas.def_en: a specialist in gerontology

family_guide.root_logic: 以 geriatric 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 该死的, 完全的, 十足的, 讨厌的
lemmas.def_en: expletives used informally as intensifiers

examples.en: I spent the whole morning looking for those goddamned car keys.
examples.zh: 我花了一整个上午找那些该死的车钥匙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 goddamned 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in a subsequent part of this document or statement or matter etc.

examples.en: Global Logistics Company, hereinafter referred to as the Supplier, signed the contract.
examples.zh: 环球物流公司（下文简称“供应商”）签署了该合同。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hereinafter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (Greek mythology) a sea god; son of Poseidon

examples.en: The physicist observed how the triton reacted during the fusion experiment.
examples.zh: 物理学家观察了氚核在聚变实验中的反应过程。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 triton 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: Old World herb with aromatic leaves and seed resembling parsley

examples.en: She sprinkled fresh coriander over the spicy chicken soup before serving it.
examples.zh: 上菜前，她在香辣鸡汤上撒了一些新鲜的芫荽。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coriander 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a suspension of insoluble particles (as plaster of Paris or lime or clay etc.) usually in water

examples.en: Workers pumped the thick concrete slurry directly into the deep foundation trenches.
examples.zh: 工人们将黏稠的混凝土泥浆直接泵入深地基沟槽中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slurry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 没法辩解的, 不可宽赦的
lemmas.def_en: without excuse or justification

examples.en: Leaving a pet locked inside a hot car is utterly inexcusable behavior.
examples.zh: 把宠物锁在闷热的车里是完全不可原谅的行为。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inexcusable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a condensed but memorable saying embodying some important fact of experience that is taken as true by many people

examples.en: He often repeated the old adage that honesty is the best policy.
examples.zh: 他经常重复那句老格言：诚实乃上策。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 adage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: trousers ending above the knee

examples.en: She packed a few pairs of cotton knickers for the weekend trip.
examples.zh: 她为周末的旅行打包了几条棉质内裤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 knickers 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 君主, 王侯, 臣下
lemmas.def_en: a person holding a fief; a person who owes allegiance and service to a feudal lord

examples.en: The loyal knight bowed low before his liege and pledged his sword.
examples.zh: 忠诚的骑士向他的君主深深鞠躬，并献出自己的佩剑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 liege 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a female sexual organ homologous to the penis

examples.en: The anatomy textbook clearly illustrates the structure and nerves of the clitoris.
examples.zh: 该解剖学教材清晰地展示了阴蒂的结构和神经分布。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the clitoris

examples.en: The medical textbook provided detailed diagrams illustrating human clitoral anatomy clearly.
examples.zh: 这本医学教科书提供了清晰说明人类阴蒂解剖结构的详细图解。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clitoris 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a process used for separating mixtures by virtue of differences in absorbency

examples.en: The chemist used gas chromatography to analyze the complex chemical mixture accurately.
examples.zh: 化学家使用气相色谱法精确分析了这种复杂的化学混合物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chromatography 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 将（两个或多个不同事物）混淆，合并（为一体）
lemmas.def_en: [T] (formal) To combine two or more separate things, especially ideas, concepts, or texts, into one whole, often creating confusion.

examples.en: Be careful not to conflate being extremely busy with being truly productive.
examples.zh: 注意不要把极度忙碌与真正富有成效混为一谈。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 conflate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （蛇般）蜿蜒滑行，滑动；不稳地滑动
lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ across/into/down) To slide smoothly along a surface with a twisting, sinuous motion; to slip or slide unsteadily.

examples.en: We watched the garden snake slither silently through the tall, wet grass.
examples.zh: 我们看着那条花园蛇悄无声息地在潮湿的高草丛中滑行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slither 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 方阵, 密集队列, 密集的人群(或兽群), 指骨, 趾骨
lemmas.def_en: any of the bones of the fingers or toes

examples.en: A phalanx of riot police stood firmly to block the crowded intersection.
examples.zh: 一队防暴警察整齐列阵，牢牢阻挡了拥挤的十字路口。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the bones of the fingers or toes

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phalanx 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 密码使用法, 密码学
lemmas.def_en: the science of analyzing and deciphering codes and ciphers and cryptograms

examples.en: Modern financial security relies heavily on advanced cryptography to protect user transactions.
examples.zh: 现代金融安全高度依赖先进的密码学来保护用户交易。

lemmas.def_en: decoder skilled in the analysis of codes and cryptograms

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cryptography 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a lever used by a pilot to control the ailerons and elevators of an airplane

examples.en: The young pilot pulled back on the joystick to gain altitude quickly.
examples.zh: 年轻的飞行员向后拉动操纵杆以快速爬升高度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 joystick 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: used of organisms (especially of different species) living together but not necessarily in a relation beneficial to each

examples.en: Fungi and tree roots form a symbiotic relationship that benefits them both.
examples.zh: 真菌和树根形成了对彼此都有益的共生关系。

lemmas.def_en: in a symbiotic manner
the relation between two different species of organisms that are interdependent; each gains benefits from the other

examples.en: The clownfish and the sea anemone maintain a classic marine symbiosis for survival.
examples.zh: 小丑鱼和海葵维持着一种经典的海洋共生关系以求生存。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 symbiotic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a chemical agent capable of reducing the surface tension of a liquid in which it is dissolved

examples.en: This mild surfactant helps clean oily dishes without drying out your hands.
examples.zh: 这种温和的表面活性剂有助于清洗油腻餐具且不伤手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 surfactant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To be connected in such a way that each thing affects or depends on the other, or to make things relate to each other.

examples.en: The professor explained how local climate and global ocean currents closely interrelate.
examples.zh: 教授解释了局部气候与全球洋流是如何紧密相互关联的。

lemmas.def_en: mutual or reciprocal relation or relatedness

examples.en: interrelationships of animal structure and function

lemmas.def_en: mutual or reciprocal relation or relatedness

examples.en: interrelationships of animal structure and function

lemmas.def_en: mutual or reciprocal relation or relatedness

examples.en: interrelationships of animal structure and function

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 紧密相关的，相互联系的
lemmas.def_en: relating to each other; having a close mutual relationship or connection
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于学术或分析语境，探讨系统、因素或问题之间的相互依存关系，如 interrelated factors / issues / systems。

examples.en: Economic growth and environmental protection are closely interrelated challenges.
examples.zh: 经济增长和环境保护是密切相关的两大挑战。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 interrelate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small two-wheeled cart for one passenger; pulled by one person

examples.en: We hired a traditional rickshaw to travel through the narrow historical streets.
examples.zh: 我们租了一辆传统人力车穿过狭窄的历史街区。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rickshaw 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cosmetic preparation used by women in Egypt and Arabia to darken the edges of their eyelids

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (law) To officially cancel or delay the punishment of a prisoner, especially a death sentence. 2. [T] To give temporary relief or an postponement from something unpleasant or dangerous.

examples.zh: 这场意外的降雨让人们暂时摆脱了酷暑的煎熬。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 takeout 为核心的派生词族。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bosh 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the master gland of the endocrine system; located at the base of the brain

examples.en: The pituitary gland produces hormones that control various critical functions throughout the body.

examples.zh: 雄孔雀自豪地展示出绚丽的羽毛，以吸引附近的配偶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plumage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: variably colored and sometimes variegated hard tough elastic wood of a sycamore tree

examples.zh: 他们安详地坐在那棵古老悬铃木的阴凉下乘凉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sycamore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有斑点的, 有污点的, 质量不一的, 发疹的

examples.zh: 在过去的两个月里，他参加训练的情况相当不稳定。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spotty 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 批评人士认为这场政治辩论是一场毫无意义的杂耍，转移了人们对实际问题的关注。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sideshow 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 山扁豆, 番泻叶, 轻泻剂

family_guide.root_logic: 以 senna 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: offensive term for an openly homosexual man

lemmas.def_en: the bottom of a sea or ocean

examples.en: Marine biologists deployed a specialized robotic camera to explore the deep ocean seabed.
examples.zh: 海洋生物学家部署了一台专用水下机器人摄像机来探索深海海床。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seabed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 家具被覆材料, 家具装饰用品业
lemmas.def_en: covering (padding and springs and webbing and fabric) on a piece of furniture

examples.en: We chose a durable leather upholstery to protect the new living room sofa.
examples.zh: 我们选择了耐用的皮革软包面料来保护客厅的新沙发。

lemmas.def_zh: 室内装璜商, 家具商
lemmas.def_en: a craftsman who upholsters furniture

lemmas.def_zh: 为（沙发、椅子等）装上垫子和面料，装璜
lemmas.def_en: [T] To cover a chair or sofa with padding, springs, and fabric or leather.

examples.en: They hired a specialist to upholster the antique armchair in blue velvet.
examples.zh: 他们聘请了一位专家用蓝色天鹅绒为这把古董扶手椅包面。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 upholstery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a tax imposed on ships that enter the US; based on the tonnage of the ship

examples.en: The port expanded its docks to accommodate cargo ships of much larger tonnage.
examples.zh: 该港口扩建了码头，以容纳吨位大得多的货轮。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tonnage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to recombinant DNA

examples.en: Scientists use recombinant DNA technology to produce essential human insulin in modern laboratories.
examples.zh: 科学家在现代实验室利用重组DNA技术生产人体必需的胰岛素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 recombinant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 憔悴的, 形容枯槁的, 野性的

examples.zh: 连续熬夜工作三个晚上后，他看起来脸色苍白且憔悴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 haggard 为核心的派生词族。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dickie 为核心的派生词族。

examples.en: Advances in artificial intelligence could conceivably change every industry in the near future.
examples.zh: 人工智能的进步完全有可能在不久的将来改变每一个行业。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 conceivably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: overbearing pride or presumption

examples.en: His fatal hubris prevented him from listening to valid warnings from his team.
examples.zh: 他致命的傲慢使他听不进团队提出的中肯警告。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hubris 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 欢呼声, 骚动, 欢乐
lemmas.def_en: a victory cheer

examples.zh: 当我们队踢进致胜一球时，观众席爆发出一阵热烈的欢呼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hurrah 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 眼睛的, 用眼的, 凭视觉的, 目击的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or resembling the eye

examples.zh: 医生进行了全面的眼部检查，以评估该患者的视网膜健康。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ocular 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the syllable naming the first (tonic) note of any major scale in solmization

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doh 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: being one more than seventeen

family_guide.root_logic: 以 xviii 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 充满激情的, 狂热的, 热烈的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by intense emotion

examples.en: The activist delivered an impassioned speech defending human rights in front of city hall.
examples.zh: 这位活动家在市政厅前发表了一场捍卫人权的慷慨激昂的演说。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impassioned 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 仓库, 贮藏所, 受托者

examples.zh: 中央银行将价值数百万美元的金条存放在一个安全的金库中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 depository 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (slang) offensive names for a White man

examples.zh: 激进活动家将当地少数族裔面临的体制性压迫归咎于白人统治阶层。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whitey 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 赔偿, 保障, 补偿, 赦免, 保护

examples.zh: 签署的保险合同在发生意外财产损失时提供全额赔偿。

lemmas.def_zh: 赔偿, 补偿(金), 保障
lemmas.def_en: a sum of money paid in compensation for loss or injury

examples.zh: 合同包含一项条款，保证对任何经济损失进行全额赔偿。

examples.zh: 保险公司同意赔偿该企业的任何财产损失。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indemnity 为核心的派生词族。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gratis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 客观的, 和个人无关的, 没有人情味的, 非人称的

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impersonal 为核心的派生词族。

he could feel the tenseness of her body

examples.zh: 他们在一家热闹的乡村小酒吧停下来跳舞喝冰啤酒。

examples.zh: 残酷的暴君对乞讨食物的可怜人毫无怜悯之心。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gash 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: without bias; without selfish motives

lemmas.def_zh: 公正无私；漠不关心；不感兴趣

examples.zh: 添加个人经历有助于使你文章中枯燥的历史事实变得富有温情。

examples.zh: 警方迅速介入，制止了酒吧外一场激烈的扭打。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scuffle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 准假，给予准假；使停薪休假，暂时解雇
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To give temporary leave of absence to an employee, soldier, or prisoner. 2. To temporarily lay off workers without pay, usually because of lack of funds or work.

examples.en: The company had to furlough dozens of factory workers during the severe economic downturn.
examples.zh: 在严重的经济低迷时期，公司不得不让数十名工厂工人暂时休假。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 furlough 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To make someone or something famous forever through a book, painting, film, or monument.

examples.en: The poet sought to immortalize the brave deeds of the fallen soldiers in verse.
examples.zh: 诗人试图用诗句让阵亡士兵的英勇事迹名垂千古。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (chiefly British) To make someone or something famous forever through a book, painting, film, or monument.

examples.en: This sculpture commemorates the victims of the concentration camps
We memorialized the Dead

family_guide.root_logic: 以 immortalize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 浪费的, 挥霍的, 丰富的
lemmas.def_en: recklessly wasteful

examples.en: His prodigal lifestyle soon depleted the substantial fortune he had inherited from his parents.
examples.zh: 他挥霍无度的生活方式很快就耗尽了他从父母那里继承的巨额财富。

lemmas.def_zh: 浪费, 挥霍, 慷慨, 丰富, 大量
lemmas.def_en: the trait of spending extravagantly
to a wasteful manner or to a wasteful degree

examples.en: we are still prodigally rich compared to others

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prodigal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 葡萄酒酿造者；葡萄酒生产者
lemmas.def_en: someone who makes wine

examples.en: The skilled winemaker carefully examined the fermenting grape juice in the oak barrels.
examples.zh: 技术精湛的酿酒师仔细检查了橡木桶中发酵的葡萄汁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 winemaker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an old term for an electric generator that produces alternating current (especially in automobiles)

examples.en: A faulty alternator was the reason my car battery kept losing its charge overnight.
examples.zh: 交流发电机出现故障是我的汽车电池整夜都在跑电的原因。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 alternator 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: adornment consisting of a bunch of cords fastened at one end

examples.en: Each graduate wore a crimson cap decorated with a shining golden silk tassel.
examples.zh: 每位毕业生都戴着一顶饰有闪亮金黄色丝穗的深红色帽子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tassel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: angered at something unjust or wrong

examples.en: She became indignant when the manager falsely accused her of stealing the office supplies.
examples.zh: 当经理诬告她偷窃办公用品时，她变得十分愤慨。

lemmas.def_en: in an indignant manner

examples.en: Miss Burney protested indignantly, her long thin nose turning pink with mortification at this irreverent piece of mimicry

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indignant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a substance for packing a joint or coating a porous surface to make it impervious to gas or liquid

examples.en: The wandering minstrel played a melancholy ballad on his wooden lute by the fire.
examples.zh: 流浪歌手在火堆旁用他的木制鲁特琴演奏了一首忧伤的民谣。

lemmas.def_en: a musician who plays the lute

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lute 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a gangster's pistol

examples.en: The nervous gangster tucked his heavy gat inside the pocket of his long trench coat.
examples.zh: 紧张的歹徒将他沉重的手枪塞进了长风衣的口袋里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who records the transactions of a business

examples.en: Our small business hired an experienced bookkeeper to manage the daily accounts and invoices.
examples.zh: 我们的小企业雇了一位经验丰富的簿记员来管理日常账目和发票。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bookkeeper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 热心者, 狂热者, 犹太教狂热信徒
lemmas.def_en: a member of an ancient Jewish sect in Judea in the first century who fought to the death against the Romans and who killed or persecuted Jews who collaborated with the Romans

examples.en: He was regarded as a dangerous zealot who refused to compromise on his extreme beliefs.
examples.zh: 他被视为一个危险的狂热分子，拒绝在自己的极端信仰上做出妥协。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 zealot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 跛行，蹒跚；束缚（马等的腿）；妨碍，阻碍
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] to walk with difficulty, taking small or uneven steps because of injury or pain 2. [T] to tie the legs of an animal together; hamper or restrict

examples.en: The twisted ankle forced the injured athlete to hobble slowly off the soccer field.
examples.zh: 脚踝扭伤迫使受伤的运动员缓慢地跛行走下足球场。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hobble 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一种长毛垂耳狗, 马屁精
lemmas.def_en: any of several breeds of small to medium-sized gun dogs with a long silky coat and long frilled ears

examples.en: The playful cocker spaniel wagged its tail happily as the children threw the ball.
examples.zh: 当孩子们扔球时，活泼的可卡犬高兴地摇着尾巴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spaniel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 少付……报酬，付给……过低的工资
lemmas.def_en: [T] To pay a worker less money than they deserve or less than the statutory rate.

examples.en: Many fast-food chains routinely underpay their staff despite reporting record annual profits.
examples.zh: 许多快餐连锁店尽管报告了创纪录的年利润，但仍经常少付员工薪水。

lemmas.def_zh: （underpay的过去式及过去分词）少付……报酬，付给……过低的工资
lemmas.def_en: [T] Past tense and past participle of underpay: to pay too little money for work done.
a payment smaller than needed or expected

family_guide.root_logic: 以 underpay 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 抢夺，夺取；费力取得；猛扭
lemmas.def_en: [T] (+ from) To take power, control, or an object away from someone violently or with great effort.

examples.en: The opposition party managed to wrest control of the parliament after a bitter election.
examples.zh: 经过一场激烈的选举，反对党成功夺取了议会的控制权。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wrest 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 从防备较弱的一侧袭击；使措手不及，使遭受突如其来的打击
lemmas.def_en: [T] To attack or hit someone unexpectedly from a direction where they cannot see, or surprise someone with an unforeseen difficulty.

examples.en: The sudden resignation of our chief executive officer completely blindsided the entire board.
examples.zh: 首席执行官的突然辞职让整个董事会感到措手不及。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blindside 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 比……存活更久，比……维持更长
lemmas.def_en: [T] To continue to exist, survive, or remain effective longer than someone or something else.

examples.en: This sturdy leather hiking boot was specially designed to outlast several pairs of sneakers.
examples.zh: 这款结实的皮质登山靴经过专门设计，使用寿命比好几双运动鞋还要长。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outlast 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large herbivorous tropical American arboreal lizards with a spiny crest along the back; used as human food in Central America and South America

examples.en: A large green iguana lay completely motionless on the branch, absorbing the morning sunlight.
examples.zh: 一只巨大的绿鬣蜥一动不动地趴在树枝上吸收晨光。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 iguana 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 坏人, (尤指电影中之)恶人
lemmas.def_en: the principal bad character in a film or work of fiction

examples.en: The actor became famous worldwide after playing a charismatic baddie in the action movie.
examples.zh: 这位演员在动作片中饰演了一个充满魅力的反派角色后闻名世界。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 baddie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 游荡, 錾, 尖头棒
lemmas.def_en: an anxiety disorder characterized by chronic free-floating anxiety and such symptoms as tension or sweating or trembling or lightheadedness or irritability etc that has lasted for more than six months

examples.en: He wasted the whole summer vacation on a restless gad through several European cities.
examples.zh: 他把整个暑假都浪费在游历几个欧洲城市的闲逛中。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] ('gad about/around') (informal) To travel or wander from place to place in search of pleasure or amusement.

examples.en: He wasted the whole summer vacation on a restless gad through several European cities.
examples.zh: 他把整个暑假都浪费在游历几个欧洲城市的闲逛中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gad 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large-flowered garden plant derived chiefly from the wild pansy of Europe and having velvety petals of various colors

examples.en: She carefully planted a purple pansy alongside the stone path in her front garden.
examples.zh: 她在前花园的石径旁小心翼翼地种下了一朵紫色三色堇。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pansy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an aperture or hole that opens into a bodily cavity

examples.en: High-pressure steam rushed rapidly out of the narrow metal orifice of the machine.
examples.zh: 高压蒸汽迅速从机器狭窄的金属孔口中喷出。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 orifice 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: lap at the front of a coat; continuation of the coat collar

examples.en: The proud politician pinned a small national flag badge to the lapel of his jacket.
examples.zh: 那位自豪的政客在夹克翻领上别了一枚小国旗徽章。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lapel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 匆匆忙忙的, 草率的, 粗略的
lemmas.def_en: hasty and without attention to detail; not thorough

examples.en: He gave the document only a cursory glance before signing his name.
examples.zh: 他在签名之前只是草草看了一眼这份文件。

lemmas.def_zh: 粗糙地, 马虎地, 疏忽地
lemmas.def_en: without taking pains

examples.en: he looked cursorily through the magazine

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cursory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 改述，重述，换种说法表达
lemmas.def_en: [T] To express an idea, statement, or question again using different words to make it clearer or more acceptable.

examples.en: Let me rephrase the question so that everyone can understand the main point.
examples.zh: 让我换个说法提问，以便大家都能理解要点。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rephrase 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: outfitting a ship again (by repairing or replacing parts)

examples.en: The cruise ship returned to service after a complete six-month interior refit.
examples.zh: 经过六个月的全面内部整修后，这艘游轮重新投入使用。

lemmas.def_zh: 整修，改装，翻新（船只、车辆或机器）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To repair, clean, and equip a ship, building, or machine with new parts or fittings.

examples.en: The cruise ship returned to service after a complete six-month interior refit.
examples.zh: 经过六个月的全面内部整修后，这艘游轮重新投入使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 refit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of medicine dealing with the endocrine glands and their secretions

examples.en: She decided to specialize in endocrinology to study hormone disorders and diabetes.
examples.zh: 她决定攻读内分泌学专业，以研究激素紊乱和糖尿病。

lemmas.def_en: physician who specializes in the diagnosis and treatment of conditions affecting the endocrine system

family_guide.root_logic: 以 endocrinology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小巷, 窄街, 走廊
lemmas.def_en: a narrow street with walls on both sides

examples.en: They took a dark alleyway as a shortcut to reach the subway station.
examples.zh: 他们走了一条黑暗的小巷作为捷径前往地铁站。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 alleyway 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a request by the manufacturer of a defective product to return the product (as for replacement or repair)

examples.en: The actor felt nervous while waiting for a callback after the second audition.
examples.zh: 在第二次试镜后等待复试通知时，这位演员感到很紧张。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 callback 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a trivalent metalloid element; occurs both in a hard black crystal and in the form of a yellow or brown powder

examples.en: Boron is commonly added to glass to improve its resistance to thermal shock.
examples.zh: 硼通常被添加到玻璃中以提高其抗热震性。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or derived from or containing boron

examples.en: She used a diluted boric acid solution to effectively treat the minor skin irritation.
examples.zh: 她使用稀释的硼酸溶液来有效治疗轻微的皮肤过敏。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to boron

family_guide.root_logic: 以 boron 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a ship with a reinforced bow to break up ice and keep channels open for navigation

examples.en: The giant nuclear icebreaker carved a wide channel through the frozen Arctic sea.
examples.zh: 巨大的核动力破冰船在封冻的北冰洋上开出一条宽阔的航道。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 icebreaker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the thin fibrous bark of the paper mulberry and Pipturus albidus

examples.en: The islanders presented the guests with intricate garments made from traditional tapa cloth.
examples.zh: 岛民向客人们展示了用传统塔帕布制作的精致服装。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tapa 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 五旬节的, 五旬节派教会的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or characteristic of any of various Pentecostal religious bodies or their members

examples.en: The local Pentecostal church held an energetic service filled with music and prayer.
examples.zh: 当地的五旬节派教会举行了一场充满音乐与祈祷的充满活力的礼拜。

lemmas.def_en: any member of a Pentecostal religious body

examples.en: The local Pentecostal church held an energetic service filled with music and prayer.
examples.zh: 当地的五旬节派教会举行了一场充满音乐与祈祷的充满活力的礼拜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pentecostal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or using a general formulation that serves to guide investigation

examples.en: Scientists often rely on heuristic techniques when exact solutions are impossible to compute.
examples.zh: 当无法计算出精确解时，科学家往往依赖启发式方法。

lemmas.def_en: a commonsense rule (or set of rules) intended to increase the probability of solving some problem

examples.en: Scientists often rely on heuristic techniques when exact solutions are impossible to compute.
examples.zh: 当无法计算出精确解时，科学家往往依赖启发式方法。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heuristic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To refuse or be unable to believe that something is true, real, or accurate.

examples.en: He seemed to disbelieve my story despite the clear evidence I provided today.
examples.zh: 尽管我今天提供了明确的证据，他似乎仍然怀疑我的说法。

lemmas.def_en: someone who refuses to believe (as in a divinity)
in an incredulous manner

examples.en: the woman looked up at her incredulously

lemmas.def_en: feeling or expressing disbelief; skeptical or incredulous
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于修饰人的神态、眼神或笑声，如 a disbelieving look / smile / shake of the head。

examples.en: He gave a disbelieving laugh when told the absurd rumor.
examples.zh: 当听到那荒谬的谣言时，他发出了一声难以置信的苦笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disbelieve 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 10 grams

examples.en: The technician carefully coated the machine parts with a fine layer of dag.
examples.zh: 技术人员小心地在机器部件上涂抹了一层薄薄的石墨润滑剂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dag 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 减弱，降低；抑止（呼吸，多用于 with bated breath）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (archaic) To lessen, diminish, or moderate; to hold back or suppress (force or breath).

examples.en: The anxious crowd waited with bated breath for the final election results.
examples.zh: 焦急的人群屏息凝神地等待着最终的选举结果。

lemmas.def_zh: 用球棒击球；击打，拍打；眨（眼）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To hit a ball with a bat, or take a turn at batting in baseball or cricket. 2. [T] To hit or strike something lightly and quickly with a hand or paw. 3. [T] To open and close one's eyes quickly (especially in 'bat an eyelid').

examples.en: He didn't even bat an eye when told about the sudden price increase.
examples.zh: 得知价格突然上涨的消息时，他甚至连眼皮都没眨一下。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 薄木片, 细木梗, 夹板, 薄金属片
lemmas.def_en: a thin sliver of wood

examples.en: The paramedic quickly placed a wooden splint on the player's fractured arm.
examples.zh: 急救医务人员迅速在受伤队员骨折的手臂上固定了木制夹板。

lemmas.def_zh: （用夹板）固定（骨折或受伤部位）
lemmas.def_en: [T] To support and immobilize an injured bone or limb with a splint.

examples.en: The paramedic quickly placed a wooden splint on the player's fractured arm.
examples.zh: 急救医务人员迅速在受伤队员骨折的手臂上固定了木制夹板。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 splint 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 逾越，超出……的限度（如职权、规则等）
lemmas.def_en: [T] To go beyond acceptable or normal limits of behavior, rules, or authority (e.g., overstep the mark).

examples.en: The manager warned the junior employee not to overstep the bounds of authority.
examples.zh: 经理警告这位初级员工不要逾越职权范围。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overstep 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To dig a dead body out of the ground after burial, especially for legal or medical investigation.

examples.en: Investigators decided to exhume the body after new suspicious evidence came to light.
examples.zh: 在新的可疑证据曝光后，调查人员决定开棺验尸。

lemmas.def_en: the act of digging something out of the ground (especially a corpse) where it has been buried

family_guide.root_logic: 以 exhume 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 剥夺（财产、土地等），强夺；逐出
lemmas.def_en: [T] (formal) to deprive someone of land, property, or possessions

examples.en: The war threatened to dispossess thousands of innocent families of their ancestral land.
examples.zh: 这场战争有可能剥夺成千上万无辜家庭世代相传的土地。

lemmas.def_zh: 强占不动产, 驱逐, 夺取
lemmas.def_en: the expulsion of someone (such as a tenant) from the possession of land by process of law

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dispossess 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 翻找，搜寻，翻箱倒柜地找
lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ through/in/around) To search for something by moving things around carelessly and hurriedly.

examples.en: She had to rummage through her messy desk drawer to find the missing key.
examples.zh: 她只得在凌乱的抽屉里仔细翻寻，寻找丢失的钥匙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rummage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woman entrusted with the care and supervision of a child (especially in a private home)

examples.en: The wealthy family hired an experienced governess to educate their young daughters at home.
examples.zh: 这个富裕的家庭聘请了一位经验丰富的女家庭教师在家里教育幼女。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 governess 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使协调，使适应，使合拍；为……调音
lemmas.def_en: [T] (+ to) (often passive) To make someone or something sensitive to, aware of, or in harmony with a situation or mood.

examples.en: Leaders must attune themselves to the changing needs and expectations of their workforce.
examples.zh: 领导者必须使自己适应员工不断变化的需求和期望。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 attune 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a behavioral attribute that is distinctive and peculiar to an individual

examples.en: His peculiar mannerism of tapping the desk annoyed everyone during the quiet meeting.
examples.zh: 他在安静的会议上敲桌子的古怪习惯惹恼了所有人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mannerism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: male sex hormone that is produced in the testes and responsible for typical male sexual characteristics

examples.en: The doctor ran tests to check if an excess of androgen caused the symptoms.
examples.zh: 医生进行了检测，以确认这些症状是否由雄激素过量引起。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 androgen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 地图制作, 制图学, 制图
lemmas.def_en: the making of maps and charts

examples.en: Modern cartography relies heavily on satellite imaging to produce extremely accurate digital maps.
examples.zh: 现代制图学高度依赖卫星成像来制作极其精确的数字地图。

lemmas.def_zh: 地图制作者, 制图师
lemmas.def_en: a person who makes maps
of or relating to the making of maps or charts

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cartography 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: turned or twisted toward one side; - G.K.Chesterton

examples.en: Our carefully planned vacation went awry when the flight was suddenly cancelled.
examples.zh: 当航班突然被取消时，我们精心策划的假期全泡汤了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 awry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 视听的, 视听教学的
lemmas.def_en: involving both hearing and seeing (usually relating to teaching aids)

examples.en: The teacher used audiovisual equipment to make the history lesson much more engaging.
examples.zh: 老师使用视听设备使历史课变得更加生动有趣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 audiovisual 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 错误地, 不顺当, 有缺陷地
lemmas.def_en: away from the correct or expected course

examples.en: She instantly sensed that something was amiss when she saw the unlocked front door.
examples.zh: 看到前门没锁，她立刻觉得有些不对劲。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amiss 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of mechanics concerned with the forces that cause motions of bodies

examples.en: The laboratory experiment demonstrated the basic kinetics of chemical reactions under high heat.
examples.zh: 该实验室实验展示了高温下化学反应的基本动力学特征。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kinetics 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 弗拉曼柯舞, 弗拉曼柯舞曲
lemmas.def_en: guitar music composed for dancing the flamenco

examples.en: The rhythmic sound of flamenco music drifted out from the lively downtown tavern.
examples.zh: 热闹的市中心小酒馆里飘出了弗拉门戈音乐富有节奏感的曲调。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flamenco 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in an idle manner

examples.en: He sat idly on the park bench, watching the leaves drift along the river.
examples.zh: 他无所事事地坐在公园长椅上，看着树叶顺着河流漂走。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 idly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an infectious disease of the tropics transmitted by mosquitoes and characterized by rash and aching head and joints

examples.en: Public health officials warned local residents about the recent outbreak of dengue fever.
examples.zh: 公共卫生官员就近期爆发的登革热疫情向当地居民发出了警告。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dengue 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the univalent hydrocarbon radical C2H5 derived from ethane by the removal of one hydrogen atom

examples.en: The chemical factory uses ethyl alcohol as an essential solvent in producing paints.
examples.zh: 这家化工厂在生产油漆时使用乙醇作为一种基本的溶剂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ethyl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the body of citizens of a state or country

examples.en: An educated citizenry is absolutely essential for the healthy functioning of any democracy.
examples.zh: 受过良好教育的公民群体对于任何民主体制的健康运行都至关重要。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 citizenry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 农事, 饲养业, 家政
lemmas.def_en: the practice of cultivating the land or raising stock

examples.en: Traditional animal husbandry practices are still widely observed in these rural farming communities.
examples.zh: 传统的畜牧养殖方式在这些农村农耕社区中仍然被广泛采用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 husbandry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: designed to be unfastened or disconnected without damage

examples.en: The winter coat features a detachable hood that can be easily unzipped anytime.
examples.zh: 这件冬装大衣配有一个可拆卸的兜帽，随时可以轻松拉开拉链取下。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 detachable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 暑热地, 激烈地, 热心地
lemmas.def_en: in a heated manner

examples.en: The proposed tax increase was hotly debated by members of parliament all afternoon.
examples.zh: 议员们整整一个下午都在激烈辩论拟议中的增税方案。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hotly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 除去面部皱纹的整容手术
lemmas.def_en: plastic surgery to remove wrinkles and other signs of aging from your face; an incision is made near the hair line and skin is pulled back and excess tissue is excised

examples.en: After turning fifty, the actress decided to undergo a facelift to restore her youth.
examples.zh: 年满五十之后，这位女演员决定做面部拉皮手术以重现青春。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 facelift 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 着火的, 闪亮的, 激昂的
lemmas.def_en: keenly excited (especially sexually) or indicating excitement; - Bram Stoker

examples.en: The night sky was ablaze with vivid colors during the spectacular fireworks show.
examples.zh: 在壮丽的烟火表演中，夜空被绚丽的色彩照得通明。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ablaze 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a method of treatment that manipulates body structures (especially the spine) to relieve low back pain or even headache or high blood pressure

examples.en: He turned to chiropractic therapy after conventional medicine failed to relieve his back pain.
examples.zh: 在传统医学无法缓解他的背痛之后，他转向了脊柱按摩疗法。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chiropractic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (Judaism) a precept or commandment of the Jewish law

examples.en: Helping the elderly neighbor carry her heavy groceries was seen as a good mitzvah.
examples.zh: 帮助年迈的邻居搬运沉重的食品杂物被视为一件行善积德的善事。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mitzvah 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of medicine dealing with childbirth and care of the mother

examples.en: She completed her degree in midwifery and now safely delivers babies at home.
examples.zh: 她完成了助产学学位，现在为家庭提供安全可靠的接生服务。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 midwifery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 周围, 社会环境, 环境, 表达的手法
lemmas.def_en: the environmental condition

examples.en: Growing up in a rich artistic milieu deeply inspired her career as a painter.
examples.zh: 在浓厚的艺术氛围中长大，深刻启发了她的画家生涯。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 milieu 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the myocardium

examples.en: Prompt medical treatment can prevent permanent myocardial damage after a heart attack.
examples.zh: 及时就医可以预防心脏病发作后的永久性心肌损伤。

lemmas.def_en: the middle muscular layer of the heart wall

examples.en: The severe heart attack caused permanent and irreversible damage to his myocardium.
examples.zh: 这次严重的心脏病发作对他的心肌造成了永久且不可逆的损伤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 myocardial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 马金托什防水布, 马金托什雨衣
lemmas.def_en: a lightweight waterproof (usually rubberized) fabric

examples.en: He put on his classic mackintosh before stepping out into the pouring rain.
examples.zh: 在走进倾盆大雨之前，他穿上了那件经典的防水雨衣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mackintosh 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 以死亡为主题的, 可怕的
lemmas.def_en: shockingly repellent; inspiring horror

examples.en: The old abandoned mansion had a macabre atmosphere that terrified all visitors.
examples.zh: 那座废弃的老宅笼罩着一种令所有访客毛骨悚然的可怖氛围。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 macabre 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 俗人, 门外汉, 凡人
lemmas.def_en: someone who is not a clergyman or a professional person

examples.en: The doctor explained the complex medical condition in terms any layman could understand.
examples.zh: 医生用任何门外汉都能听懂的语言解释了这一复杂的病情。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 layman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large and distinctive landmass (as India or Greenland) that is a distinct part of some continent

examples.en: Monsoon rains bring essential water to millions of farmers across the vast subcontinent.
examples.zh: 季风降雨为辽阔次大陆上的数百万农民带来了不可或缺的水源。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subcontinent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 身体的, 肉体的, 壁体的
lemmas.def_en: affecting or characteristic of the body as opposed to the mind or spirit

examples.en: Chronic emotional stress often manifests itself in the form of physical somatic symptoms.
examples.zh: 长期的心理压力常常以身体躯体症状的形式显现出来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 somatic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 偏袒亲属, 起用亲戚
lemmas.def_en: favoritism shown to relatives or close friends by those in power (as by giving them jobs)

examples.en: The company strictly forbids nepotism to ensure all hiring is based entirely on merit.
examples.zh: 公司严禁任人唯亲，以确保所有招聘完全基于个人能力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nepotism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 长方形的, 长椭圆形的
lemmas.def_en: (of a leaf shape) having a somewhat elongated form with approximately parallel sides

examples.en: She placed a fresh vase of roses in the center of the oblong table.
examples.zh: 她在长方形桌子的中央摆放了一瓶新鲜的玫瑰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oblong 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: being one more than twenty

examples.en: The historian analyzed major economic trends throughout the early XXI century.
examples.zh: 历史学家分析了整个二十一世纪初期的主要经济趋势。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 xxi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使人生厌，变得乏味，失去吸引力
lemmas.def_en: [I] To become uninteresting, boring, or tiresome, especially because of having had too much of something.

examples.en: The constant bad weather began to pall on everyone during their beach holiday.
examples.zh: 海滩度假期间连绵不断的坏天气开始让所有人感到索然无味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pall 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 二十三；致谢；尽职尽责
lemmas.def_en: being three more than twenty

examples.en: Please turn to chapter XXIII of the textbook for today's reading assignment.
examples.zh: 请翻到教科书的第二十三章以查看今天的阅读作业。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 xxiii 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a ventricle (of the heart or brain)

examples.en: Doctors closely monitored the patient for any signs of dangerous ventricular arrhythmia.
examples.zh: 医生密切监测患者是否有危险的室性心律失常迹象。

lemmas.def_en: one of four connected cavities in the brain; is continuous with the central canal of the spinal cord and contains cerebrospinal fluid

examples.en: The left ventricle pumps oxygenated blood to the rest of the body.
examples.zh: 左心室将含氧血液泵送到身体的其他部位。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ventricular 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 同等的, 相等的, 相当于...的
lemmas.def_en: being essentially equal to something

examples.en: Refusing to sign the document was considered tantamount to admitting full guilt.
examples.zh: 拒绝签署该文件被认为等同于承认全部罪行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tantamount 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: made with sleeves or sleeves especially as specified; often used in combination

examples.en: She prefers wearing long-sleeved cotton shirts during chilly autumn evenings.
examples.zh: 她喜欢在凉爽的秋夜穿长袖棉质衬衫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sleeved 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: to that

examples.en: The contract and all amendments attached thereto must be signed by both parties.
examples.zh: 合同以及所有附随其中的修正案均须由双方签字。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thereto 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 容易感知地；聪明地；明显地
lemmas.def_en: with good sense or in a reasonable or intelligent manner

examples.en: She decided sensibly to invest her annual bonus rather than spend it immediately.
examples.zh: 她理智地决定把年终奖投资，而不是立即花掉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sensibly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大锤, 极有分量的事物
lemmas.def_en: a heavy long-handled hammer used to drive stakes or wedges

examples.en: Workers used a heavy sledgehammer to demolish the old concrete garden wall.
examples.zh: 工人们用一把重磅大锤拆除了花园里的旧混凝土墙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sledgehammer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having a common center

examples.en: The falling pebble created a series of widening concentric ripples on the lake.
examples.zh: 落下的卵石在湖面上泛起一圈圈不断扩大的同心涟漪。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of having the same center (as circles inside one another)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 concentric 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 非决定性的, 犹豫不决的, 不明确的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by lack of decision and firmness

examples.en: His indecisive leadership during the crisis caused significant delays and general confusion.
examples.zh: 他在危机期间优柔寡断的领导导致了严重的拖延和混乱。

lemmas.def_en: doubt concerning two or more possible alternatives or courses of action

examples.en: his indecision was only momentary but the opportunity was lost

lemmas.def_en: lacking firmness or resoluteness

examples.en: `I don't know,' he said indecisively

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indecisive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 新贵, 暴发户, 自命不凡者
lemmas.def_en: an arrogant or presumptuous person

examples.en: The small tech upstart quickly disrupted the entire established smartphone industry.
examples.zh: 这家小小的科技新贵迅速颠覆了整个既有的智能手机行业。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 upstart 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the mathematics of triangles and trigonometric functions

examples.en: High school students often learn basic trigonometry to calculate various angles and distances.
examples.zh: 高中生通常学习基础三角学来计算各种角度和距离。

lemmas.def_zh: 三角法的, 三角学的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or according to the principles of trigonometry

examples.en: trigonometric function

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trigonometry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who is regarded as eccentric or mad

examples.en: He must be an absolute nutter to go swimming in freezing weather.
examples.zh: 在冰冻的天气里去游泳，他一定是个彻底的疯子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nutter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 颚, 上颚, 嘴的上(或下)部
lemmas.def_en: the jaw in vertebrates that is hinged to open the mouth

examples.en: The surgeon carefully set the broken bone in the patient's lower mandible.
examples.zh: 外科医生小心地将病人下颌的断骨复位。

lemmas.def_en: relating to the lower jaw

examples.en: The surgeon successfully repaired the fractured mandibular bone after the sports injury.
examples.zh: 外科医生成功修复了那名运动员运动创伤后的下颌骨骨折。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mandible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 剑术家, 剑客, 武士
lemmas.def_en: someone skilled at fencing

examples.en: The skilled swordsman disarmed his opponent with a single swift motion.
examples.zh: 那位技艺高超的剑客以敏捷的一招缴了对手的械。

lemmas.def_en: skill in fencing

family_guide.root_logic: 以 swordsman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a man who is (usually) old and/or eccentric

examples.en: An old geezer down the street spends his days yelling at traffic.
examples.zh: 街尾的一个怪老头成天对着过往车辆大吼大叫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 geezer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: pertaining to or characteristic of an ascetic or the practice of rigorous self-discipline

examples.en: He led an ascetic life in a small cabin away from civilization.
examples.zh: 他隐居在远离文明的简陋小屋里，过着苦行般的生活。

lemmas.def_zh: 苦行的, 禁欲(主义)的
lemmas.def_en: pertaining to or characteristic of an ascetic or the practice of rigorous self-discipline

examples.en: ascetic practices

lemmas.def_zh: 苦行者, 禁欲者, 修道者
lemmas.def_en: someone who practices self denial as a spiritual discipline

examples.en: He led an ascetic life in a small cabin away from civilization.
examples.zh: 他隐居在远离文明的简陋小屋里，过着苦行般的生活。

lemmas.def_en: in an ascetic manner

examples.en: she lived ascetically in a small house all by herself

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ascetic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a slight irregular shaking motion

examples.en: You have to jiggle the handle a bit to open the front door.
examples.zh: 你得稍微晃晃把手才能把前门打开。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To move or shake lightly and quickly from side to side or up and down, or to cause something to do this.

examples.en: You have to jiggle the handle a bit to open the front door.
examples.zh: 你得稍微晃晃把手才能把前门打开。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jiggle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）擦伤，（使）擦痛；（因受限制而）恼怒，焦躁
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To rub against skin or another surface and make it sore or worn, or to become sore by rubbing. 2. [I] To feel annoyed or impatient because of a restriction or rule.

examples.en: These stiff new leather boots chafe my ankles when I walk fast.
examples.zh: 当我走得快时，这双僵硬的新皮靴就会擦痛脚踝。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chafe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a Russian prison camp for political prisoners

examples.en: Dissidents were often sent to a harsh gulag deep in the frozen north.
examples.zh: 异见人士常常被流放到极北严寒之地的古拉格中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gulag 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small slender gull having narrow wings and a forked tail

examples.en: A white tern dived toward the ocean surface to catch a small fish.
examples.zh: 一只白燕鸥俯冲向海面，捕食一条小鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tern 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 表演特技者, 杂技演员
lemmas.def_en: an athlete who performs acts requiring skill and agility and coordination

examples.en: The acrobat balanced effortlessly on a thin wire high above the circus crowd.
examples.zh: 杂技演员在马戏团观众头顶的高空细钢丝上轻松自如地保持着平衡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 acrobat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who is dazzlingly skilled in any field

examples.en: The young piano virtuoso stunned the audience with an extraordinary and flawless performance.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的钢琴大师以非凡且无瑕的演奏震惊了全场观众。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 virtuoso 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 同时期的, 同时代的
lemmas.def_en: occurring in the same period of time

examples.en: Historians discovered contemporaneous accounts that described the battle in vivid detail.
examples.zh: 历史学家们发现了生动详细地描述了这场战役的同代记载。

lemmas.def_zh: 同时发生, 同时存在
lemmas.def_en: during the same period of time

examples.en: contemporaneously, or possibly a little later, there developed a great Sumerian civilisation

lemmas.def_zh: 同时代, 同世, 同一时期
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being current or of the present

examples.en: The exhibition celebrates the surprising contemporaneity between two very different modernist sculptors.
examples.zh: 该展览展现了两位风格截然不同的现代主义雕塑家之间惊人的同时代性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 contemporaneous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 柔和的, 温和的, 文雅的
lemmas.def_en: having a sophisticated charm

examples.en: The suave secret agent mingled effortlessly with high society at the gala.
examples.zh: 这位温文尔雅的特工在晚会上轻松自如地融入上流社会。

lemmas.def_zh: 温文尔雅地；柔和地；讨好地
lemmas.def_en: with suavity; in a suave manner

examples.en: he is suavely charming and all the ladies love him

lemmas.def_zh: 柔和, 温和, 愉快
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being bland and gracious or ingratiating in manner

family_guide.root_logic: 以 suave 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an evil supernatural being

examples.en: A background daemon monitors system resources and logs any unexpected error.
examples.zh: 后台守护进程监控系统资源并记录任何意外错误。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 daemon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who insists on great precision and correctness (especially in the use of words)

examples.en: A grammar purist would strongly object to ending sentences with a preposition.
examples.zh: 语法纯粹主义者会极力反对以介词结束句子。

lemmas.def_zh: 语言纯正主义, 纯粹派
lemmas.def_en: scrupulous or exaggerated insistence on purity or correctness (especially in language)

examples.en: His insistence on linguistic purism made modern slang completely unacceptable to him.
examples.zh: 他对语言纯正主义的坚持让他完全无法接受现代俚语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 purist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a meeting for boat races

examples.en: Hundreds of colorful sailing boats entered the annual summer regatta this year.
examples.zh: 数百艘色彩缤纷的帆船参加了今年的夏季年度赛舟会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 regatta 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 扑通落下；扑通扔下，沉重地放下
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to fall or drop heavily into water or onto a soft surface with a short, hollow sound, or to drop something in this way

examples.en: She plopped a scoop of vanilla ice cream right into the warm pie.
examples.zh: 她扑通一声把一勺香草冰淇淋扣在温热的派上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plop 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 冒名顶替者, 骗子, 冒牌
lemmas.def_en: a person who makes deceitful pretenses

examples.en: The man pretending to be a qualified doctor was unmasked as an impostor.
examples.zh: 那个假装是有资质医生的人被揭露是个冒牌货。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impostor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 恐水病的, 狂犬病的, 患恐水病的
lemmas.def_en: lacking affinity for water; tending to repel and not absorb water; tending not to dissolve in or mix with or be wetted by water

examples.en: The hydrophobic coating makes water bead up and roll off the fabric immediately.
examples.zh: 疏水涂层使水立即在织物上形成水珠并滚落。

lemmas.def_en: the property of being water-repellent; tending to repel and not absorb water

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hydrophobic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ as) (formal) To praise someone or something very enthusiastically.

examples.en: The fitness coach never ceased to extol the benefits of daily morning runs.
examples.zh: 健身教练从不吝于颂扬每天晨跑的好处。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 extol 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the kind of intellectual who converts messages from a code to plain text

examples.en: Connect the digital decoder to your television set to receive high-definition signals.
examples.zh: 将数字解码器连接到电视机上以接收高清信号。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 decoder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of zoology that studies birds

examples.en: Her passionate interest in ornithology led her to study rare Amazonian birds.
examples.zh: 她对鸟类学的浓厚兴趣促使她去研究罕见的亚马逊鸟类。

lemmas.def_en: a zoologist who studies birds
of or relating to ornithology

examples.en: her ornithological interests

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ornithology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To hear what other people are saying without their knowledge or intention.

examples.en: I could not help but overhear their conversation in the crowded restaurant.
examples.zh: 在拥挤的餐馆里，我忍不住无意中听到了他们的谈话。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overhear 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 棒糖, 硬糖, 类似棒糖的东西, 冰棍
lemmas.def_en: informal terms for money

examples.en: The little boy quietly enjoyed his strawberry lolly while sitting on the park bench.
examples.zh: 小男孩坐在公园的长椅上，静静地吃着他的草莓味棒棒糖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lolly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （弹丸、石块等受阻）弹回，跳飞，反弹
lemmas.def_en: [I] (of a bullet, stone, or ball) To hit a hard surface at an angle and bounce away.

examples.en: The stray bullet ricocheted off the concrete wall, startling everyone nearby.
examples.zh: 那颗流弹从水泥墙上反弹开来，吓坏了附近的每一个人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ricochet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 倾向一方的, 不平衡的
lemmas.def_en: having one side lower or smaller or lighter than the other

examples.en: The basketball team suffered a lopsided defeat after their best player was injured.
examples.zh: 在核心球员受伤后，该篮球队遭遇了一场悬殊的惨败。

lemmas.def_en: an oblique or slanting asymmetry
in a crooked lopsided manner

examples.en: he smiled lopsidedly

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lopsided 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: either of two masses of lymphatic tissue one on each side of the oral pharynx

examples.en: His swollen tonsils made it extremely painful to swallow anything solid.
examples.zh: 他肿胀的扁桃体导致吞咽任何固体食物都极其痛苦。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tonsil 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who marks a trail by leaving blazes on trees

examples.en: She was recognized as a trailblazer in the field of renewable energy research.
examples.zh: 她被公认为可再生能源研究领域的开拓者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trailblazer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who has had a limb removed by amputation

examples.en: With modern prosthetic technology, the amputee was able to run marathons again.
examples.zh: 凭借现代假肢技术，这位截肢者得以重新参加马拉松赛跑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amputee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: capable of or tending to change in form or quality or nature

examples.en: Spring weather here is notoriously changeable, shifting rapidly from sunshine to rain.
examples.zh: 这里春天的天气是出了名的多变，很快就会由晴转雨。

lemmas.def_zh: 不变的, 不能改变的
lemmas.def_en: not changeable or subject to change; -Ashley Montagu

examples.en: a fixed and unchangeable part of the germ plasm
the unchangeable seasons

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being changeable; having a marked tendency to change

examples.en: the changeableness of the weather

family_guide.root_logic: 以 changeable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 塞块, 木楔, 楔形木垫
lemmas.def_en: a block of wood used to prevent the sliding or rolling of a heavy object

examples.en: Make sure to chock the wheels securely before jacking up the car.
examples.zh: 在用千斤顶顶起汽车之前，务必用木楔把车轮塞紧。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ up) To block, wedge, or secure something (such as a wheel) with a chock to stop it from moving.

examples.en: Make sure to chock the wheels securely before jacking up the car.
examples.zh: 在用千斤顶顶起汽车之前，务必用木楔把车轮塞紧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）浪漫化，把……想象得富有传奇色彩（或过于美妙）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To talk or think about something in a way that makes it seem more exciting, heroic, or attractive than it really is.

examples.en: We often romanticize the past, forgetting the harsh hardships people actually faced.
examples.zh: 我们常常将过去浪漫化，却忘记了人们曾经面临的残酷苦难。

lemmas.def_zh: 使浪漫化，把……想象得过于美好；沉溺于幻想
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To talk about or view something in an idealized, unrealistic way that makes it seem better or more appealing than it really is.

examples.en: Don't romanticize this uninteresting and hard work!

lemmas.def_en: the act of indulging in sentiment

family_guide.root_logic: 以 romanticize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蔷薇结, 蔷薇花饰, 装饰圆窗
lemmas.def_en: an ornament or pattern resembling a rose that is worn as a badge of office or as recognition of having won an honor

examples.en: The winning horse proudly wore a bright blue rosette around its neck.
examples.zh: 获胜的马脖子上骄傲地佩戴着一枚鲜艳的蓝色蔷薇花结。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rosette 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 流浪者, 浪子, 流氓
lemmas.def_en: anything that resembles a vagabond in having no fixed place

examples.en: He lived as a vagabond, traveling across the continent with just a backpack.
examples.zh: 他像个流浪者一样生活，仅凭一个背包就游历了整个大陆。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (literary) To wander from place to place without a settled home or regular job.

examples.en: He lived as a vagabond, traveling across the continent with just a backpack.
examples.zh: 他像个流浪者一样生活，仅凭一个背包就游历了整个大陆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vagabond 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the highest part (usually the melody) in a piece of choral music

examples.en: The professor asked the students to analyze the symbolism in the third canto.
examples.zh: 教授要求学生们分析该长诗第三篇中的象征手法。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 canto 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 扭动，蠕动；蠕动着穿过；巧妙避开，摆脱 (wriggle out of)
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To twist and turn the body with quick, small movements; 2. [I] (wriggle out of) to cleverly avoid a duty or problem.

examples.en: The captured puppy managed to wriggle out of the toddler's clumsy embrace.
examples.zh: 被抓住的小狗设法从蹒跚学步的孩子笨拙的怀抱中挣脱了出来。

lemmas.def_en: one who can't stay still (especially a child)

examples.en: the toddler was a real wiggler on plane trips

lemmas.def_en: moving in a twisting or snake-like or wormlike fashion

examples.en: The little boy struggled to hold the wriggly puppy securely in his small arms.
examples.zh: 小男孩努力将那只扭动不停的小狗抱紧在自己的臂弯里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wriggle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 叛教的, 变节的, 脱党的
lemmas.def_en: not faithful to religion or party or cause

examples.en: The religious leader condemned the famous apostate for publicly abandoning the faith.
examples.zh: 这位宗教领袖谴责了那位公开放弃信仰的著名叛教者。

lemmas.def_en: a disloyal person who betrays or deserts his cause or religion or political party or friend etc.

examples.en: The religious leader condemned the famous apostate for publicly abandoning the faith.
examples.zh: 这位宗教领袖谴责了那位公开放弃信仰的著名叛教者。

lemmas.def_zh: 叛教, 脱党, 变节
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (formal / religion) To publicly abandon one's religious faith, political party, or core principles.

family_guide.root_logic: 以 apostate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: intelligence achieved far ahead of normal developmental schedules

examples.en: Her remarkable precocity in mathematics amazed the university professors at an early age.
examples.zh: 她在数学上非凡的早熟早早地就震惊了大学教授们。

lemmas.def_en: intelligence achieved far ahead of normal developmental schedules
characterized by or characteristic of exceptionally early development or maturity (especially in mental aptitude)

examples.en: a precocious child
a precocious achievement

lemmas.def_zh: 发育过早地, 过早发展地
lemmas.def_en: in a precocious manner

examples.en: her child behaves precociously

family_guide.root_logic: 以 precocity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a rude or vulgar fool

examples.en: He acted like a buffoon at the party just to make people laugh.
examples.zh: 他在聚会上举止滑稽如小丑，只为了逗大家发笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 buffoon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 装满的, 充满的, 充实的, 吃饱的
lemmas.def_en: filled to satisfaction with food or drink

examples.en: After the lavish seven-course feast, the guests were completely replete and content.
examples.zh: 享用完丰盛的七道菜大餐后，客人们都吃得极饱且感到满足。

lemmas.def_zh: 充满, 塞满, 饱食
lemmas.def_en: the state of being satisfactorily full and unable to take on more

family_guide.root_logic: 以 replete 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I] to spend time resting and gradually recovering health and strength after an illness or medical operation

examples.en: She took two weeks off work to convalesce at home after major surgery.
examples.zh: 大手术后，她请假两周在家休养康复。

lemmas.def_zh: 恢复中的病人, 康复的人
lemmas.def_en: a person who is recovering from illness
gradual healing (through rest) after sickness or injury

family_guide.root_logic: 以 convalesce 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 种系发生的, 系统发育的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the evolutionary development of organisms

examples.en: Scientists constructed a detailed phylogenetic tree to trace the evolutionary history of the virus.
examples.zh: 科学家构建了详细的系统发育树，以追踪该病毒的演化历史。

lemmas.def_zh: 系统发生的, 动植物演化史的, 动植物种类史的
lemmas.def_en: with regard to phylogeny

examples.en: a phylogenetically primitive part of the brain

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phylogenetic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: ( 印度的) 村务委员会, 五人长老会
lemmas.def_en: a village council in India or southern Pakistan

examples.en: The local panchayat met under the banyan tree to resolve the village dispute.
examples.zh: 当地村务委员会在榕树下集会，以解决这桩村庄纠纷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 panchayat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a young person who belongs to a British or American group that shave their heads and gather at rock concerts or engage in white supremacist demonstrations

examples.en: A group of skinheads gathered outside the concert hall, drawing suspicious looks.
examples.zh: 一群光头党聚集在音乐厅外，引来了怀疑的目光。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 skinhead 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an operation that determines whether one or more of a set of items has a specified property

examples.en: The software performs a quick database lookup to verify the customer's account details.
examples.zh: 该软件执行了快速的数据库查找，以核实客户的账户信息。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lookup 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 多晶形, 多形性, 多型现象
lemmas.def_en: (genetics) the genetic variation within a population that natural selection can operate on

examples.en: Object-oriented programming relies heavily on polymorphism to enable flexible and reusable code.
examples.zh: 面向对象编程非常依赖多态性来实现灵活且可复用的代码。

lemmas.def_zh: 多态动物(或植物), 多形体
lemmas.def_en: an organism that can assume more than one adult form as in the castes of ants or termites

examples.en: The chemist synthesized a new crystalline polymorph that demonstrated significantly higher chemical stability.
examples.zh: 这位化学家合成了一种展现出显著更高化学稳定性的新型晶体多形体。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 多形的, 多种组合形式的
lemmas.def_en: relating to the crystallization of a compound in two or more different forms

examples.en: polymorphous crystallization

lemmas.def_zh: 多种形式的, 多功能的, 多形态的
lemmas.def_en: relating to the crystallization of a compound in two or more different forms

examples.en: The virus displays a polymorphous structure that makes it extremely difficult to identify.
examples.zh: 这种病毒表现出多形态的结构，使其极难被识别。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 polymorphism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 极不公正；罪恶；不道德行为
lemmas.def_en: absence of moral or spiritual values

examples.en: The prophet spoke out fiercely against the deep iniquity within the ruling class.
examples.zh: 这位先知强烈谴责统治阶层内部深重的罪恶不公。

lemmas.phonetic: 极不公正；罪恶；不道德行为
lemmas.zh: 极不公正；罪恶；不道德行为

lemmas.def_en: characterized by iniquity; wicked because it is believed to be a sin

examples.en: iniquitous deeds
he said it was sinful to wear lipstick

family_guide.root_logic: 以 iniquity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 富裕的, 豪华的, 奢侈的, 丰富的, 大量的
lemmas.def_en: rich and superior in quality

examples.en: The billionaire hosted a lavish dinner in his opulent mansion overlooking the bay.
examples.zh: 这位亿万富翁在他俯瞰海湾的豪华豪宅里举办了丰盛的晚宴。

lemmas.def_zh: 富裕地; 豪华地; 丰裕地
lemmas.def_en: in a sumptuous and opulent manner

examples.en: this government building is sumptuously appointed

lemmas.def_zh: 富裕, 丰富, 大量
lemmas.def_en: wealth as evidenced by sumptuous living

examples.en: The grand palace was decorated with unbelievable opulence and glittering crystal chandeliers.
examples.zh: 这座宏伟的宫殿装饰得极其奢华，挂着晶莹剔透的水晶吊灯。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 opulent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 重新调整，微调；重新适应
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. [T] To adjust something again or to a new position. 2. [I] (+ to) To adapt yourself to new conditions or changes.

examples.en: She needed several weeks to readjust to normal life after living abroad.
examples.zh: 在国外生活之后，她需要几个星期来重新适应正常生活。

lemmas.def_zh: 再整理, (使)重新进入正常状态/正常位置, 再调整, (使)重新适应
lemmas.def_en: the act of adjusting again (to changed circumstances)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 readjust 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）变坚韧，（使）坚强；使（制度、法律等）更严厉
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To make something stronger or more resilient, or to become stronger. 2. To make rules, laws, or policies stricter or harsher.

examples.en: Years of surviving in the wilderness helped toughen his mind and physical endurance.
examples.zh: 多年在荒野中的求生磨砺了他的心智与耐力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 toughen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 时漏, 砂漏, 水漏；沙漏标
lemmas.def_en: a sandglass that runs for sixty minutes

examples.en: She watched the fine sand slowly trickle down inside the antique wooden hourglass.
examples.zh: 她注视着细沙在古董木制沙漏中缓缓流下。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hourglass 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a musical composition of a free form usually incorporating several familiar themes

examples.en: The pianist concluded the recital with a brilliant fantasia composed by Mozart.
examples.zh: 钢琴家以莫扎特创作的一首精彩幻想曲结束了独奏会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fantasia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 繁重的, 负有法律责任的
lemmas.def_en: not easily borne; wearing

examples.en: Managing the bankrupt company proved to be a far more onerous task than expected.
examples.zh: 管理这家破产公司被证明是一项远比预期繁重的任务。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 onerous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a toxic nonmetallic element related to sulfur and tellurium; occurs in several allotropic forms; a stable grey metallike allotrope conducts electricity better in the light than in the dark and is used in photocells; occurs in sulfide ores (as pyrite)

examples.en: Brazil nuts are an exceptionally rich natural source of the essential mineral selenium.
examples.zh: 巴西坚果是必需矿物质硒的极其丰富的天然来源。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 selenium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 赶快, 转眼间, 立刻
lemmas.def_en: suddenly; - Swift

examples.en: The magician waved his wand, whispered a magic word, and presto, the rabbit vanished.
examples.zh: 魔术师挥动魔杖，轻念咒语，转眼间兔子就消失了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 presto 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 巨型独石, 大独石碑
lemmas.def_en: a single great stone (often in the form of a column or obelisk)

examples.en: Tourists gathered around the ancient stone monolith to admire its strange carvings.
examples.zh: 游客们聚集在这座古老的石碑周围，欣赏其奇特的雕刻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 monolith 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 缺乏, 粮食不足, 饥馑
lemmas.def_en: an acute insufficiency

examples.en: The unexpected drought caused a severe dearth of fresh produce across the region.
examples.zh: 突如其来的干旱导致该地区新鲜农产品极度短缺。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dearth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in the middle of the week

examples.en: The director decided to hold an extra rehearsal midweek before the Saturday premiere.
examples.zh: 导演决定在周六首映前于周中临时加排一场戏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 midweek 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 伤害, 帮倒忙的行为
lemmas.def_en: an act intended to help that turns out badly

examples.en: Spreading unverified rumors does a great disservice to the entire scientific community.
examples.zh: 散播未经核实的谣言是对整个科学界极大的损害。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disservice 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the football players who line up on the line of scrimmage

examples.en: Brave linemen worked through the blizzard to restore electricity to the frozen town.
examples.zh: 勇敢的线路工人顶着暴风雪抢修，为冰冻的小镇恢复了供电。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 linemen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a storm in which violent winds are drawn into the column of hot air rising over a severely bombed area

examples.en: His controversial remarks sparked a political firestorm that lasted for several weeks.
examples.zh: 他引发争议的言论激起了一场持续数周的政治风暴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 firestorm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大声宣告，响亮地宣扬；吹响尖音喇叭
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (literary) To proclaim, declare, or sound a call loudly and clearly.

examples.en: The herald clarioned the sudden arrival of the king throughout the crowded castle.
examples.zh: 传令官在拥挤的城堡中吹响号角宣告国王的突然驾临。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clarion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用魔术贴粘紧，用搭扣带固定
lemmas.def_en: [T] To fasten or attach something using hook-and-loop Velcro tape.

examples.en: Please velcro the heavy protective pads securely around your knees before skating.
examples.zh: 滑冰前，请用魔术贴将厚重的护膝牢牢固定在膝盖上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 velcro 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 阴阳人, 兼具两性特征者
lemmas.def_en: one having both male and female sexual characteristics and organs; at birth an unambiguous assignment of male or female cannot be made

examples.en: Advocates work tirelessly to protect the fundamental human rights of intersex individuals.
examples.zh: 倡导者们不知疲倦地工作，以保护双性人群体的基本人权。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intersex 为核心的派生词族。
